generic.needsImprove = function(skill) if (player.skills[skill] and player.skills[skill] > 0 and player.skills[skill] < 10) then return true; end return false; end
generic.debounceTimers = generic.debounceTimers or {}
generic.debounceTimer = function(name, timeout, cmd)
if generic.debounceTimers[name] then killTimer(generic.debounceTimers[name]) end
generic.debounceTimers[name] = tempTimer(timeout, function()
generic.debounceTimers[name] = nil
if type(cmd) == 'function' then cmd() else expandAlias(cmd) end
end, 'debounce timer: ' .. name)
end
generic.debounceLockoutTimes = generic.debounceLockoutTimes or {}
generic.debounceFunction = function(name, timeout, cmd)
local execTime = getEpoch()
-- still locked out if generic.debounceLockoutTimes[name] and generic.debounceLockoutTimes[name] > execTime then
local timeoutExpires = generic.debounceLockoutTimes[name] - execTime
-- queue a debounced execution if one doesn't exist if not generic.debounceTimers[name] then generic.debounceTimer(name, timeoutExpires, cmd) generic.debounceLockoutTimes[name] = execTime + timeout + timeoutExpires end
return
end
if type(cmd) == 'function' then cmd() else expandAlias(cmd) end
generic.debounceLockoutTimes[name] = getEpoch() + timeout
end

-- -- load nouns -- local nounsFile = getMudletHomeDir() .. inspector.wtf = function(word) display(word, inspector.dictionary[word]) end
-- -- load dictionary inspector.generateDictionary = function() local dictionaryFile = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/../../masterModules/njs50-tfe/dictionary.json" local file = io.open(dictionaryFile) if (file ~= nil) then -- display(yajl.to_value(dictionaryFile)) -- display('itsa file!') local dictionary = file:read("*all"); io.close(file)
dictionary = yajl.to_value(dictionary)
local nouns = {} local synonyms = {}
for word, data in pairs(dictionary) do
for idx, meaning in ipairs(data.MEANINGS) do
if meaning[1] == 'Noun' or meaning[1] == 'Adjective' then
nouns[word] = true
for idx, synonym in ipairs(data.SYNONYMS) do synonym = synonym:upper()
if (not nouns[synonym]) then nouns[synonym] = true end
end
end
end
end
local nounFilePath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/../../masterModules/njs50-tfe/insepect_words.json" local nounFile = io.open(nounFilePath, 'w') nounFile:write(yajl.to_string(nouns)) nounFile:close() io.flush()
else display('failed to load dictionary file: ' .. dictionaryFile) end
end
-- inspector.test = function() -- -- local testData = { -- drain = { -- look = "Inch-thick bars of iron run vertically across the exit of a large ceramic pipe in the southern" -- }, -- grate = { -- look = "Inch-thick bars of iron run vertically across the exit of a large ceramic pipe in the southern" -- }, -- southern = { -- look = "Inch-thick bars of iron run vertically across the exit of a large ceramic pipe in the southern" -- }, -- wall = { -- look = "Inch-thick bars of iron run vertically across the exit of a large ceramic pipe in the southern" -- }, -- face = { look = "", search = "" }, -- scaffolding = { search = 'You search through the scraps of broken wood but find nothing.' }, -- wooden = { search = 'You search through the scraps of broken wood but find nothing.' }, -- -- } -- -- display(inspector.condense(testData)) -- -- end
inspector.condense = function(results)
-- display(results)
local xTemp = {} local xTempSearch = {}
local lookWords = {} local searchWords = {}
local lookResults = {} local searchResults = {}
for idx, data in pairs(results) do
if (data.look and data.look ~= "") then table.insert(lookWords, idx) xTemp[data.look] = xTemp[data.look] or {} table.insert(xTemp[data.look], idx) end
if (data.search and data.search ~= "") then table.insert(searchWords, idx) -- searchResults[idx] = data.search xTempSearch[data.search] = xTempSearch[data.search] or {} table.insert(xTempSearch[data.search], idx) end
end
for idx, data in pairs(xTemp) do local key = table.concat(data, ', ') lookResults[key] = idx end
for idx, data in pairs(xTempSearch) do local key = table.concat(data, ', ') searchResults[key] = idx end
return { look = lookResults, lookWords = lookWords, search = searchResults, searchWords = searchWords }
end

"your", "-", "tell", "due", "not", "seems", "should", "inspires", "their", "there", "threaten", "just", "enough", "across", "action", "precludes", "sound", "vertically", "run", "though", "through", "smell", "inches", "such", "caught", "appears", "runs", "shored", "supported", "inch-thick", "pausing", "rests", "slight", "consume", "seconds", "continue", "allow", "blocking", "heavily", "senses", "echo", "has", "held", "sounds", "least", "unbearable", "impossible", "continues", "some", "composed", "directions", "off", "probably", "placed", "moment", "lies", "movements", "low", "smells", "each", "pushed", "significant", "perhaps", "might", "expected", "shows", "hang", "air", "out", "twenty", "both", "those", "along", "leads", "inclines", "lying", "naturally", "leading", "too", "dug", "pity", "anyone", "bear", "must", "happened", "come", "what", "became", "fairly", "makes", "creep", "weeks", "time", "had", "ago", "can", "further", "does", "slowly", "barely", "was", "clearly", "intended", "system", "see", "thirty", "nothing", "extends", "crashes", "feet", "onto", "far", "size", "break", "may", "one", "look", "hakk", "connected", "short", "directly", "visible", "mile", "series", "before", "curling", "alike", "encompasses", "largely", "like", "doesnt", "descends", "also", "proper", "vast", "toward", "all", "less", "still", "even", "kept", "evident", "able", "great", "over", "juts", "while", "restrict", "straight", "topped", "next", "appear", "utilized", "signaling", "trafficked", "same", "atop", "extremely", "indicates", "multiple", "however", "proudly", "occasional", "provide", "open", "sizes", "mounted", "loose", "erected", "later", "empty", "sorts", "towards", "exposition", "acting", "obviously", "planted", "trait", "attempting", "although", "inspection", "unlike", "something", "trying", "upon", "particular", "correct", "looking", "them", "stubbornness", "were", "much", "reveals", "equally", "climb", "word", "impression", "lazy", "reaches", "several", "intersecting", "stretch", "differentiated", "endless", "tucked", "places", "predominant", "perfectly", "her", "ivory", "farther", "stretches", "letting", "walking", "add", "depicted", "agony", "his", "away", "clutching", "attention", "another", "than", "ever", "disturbing", "wake", "other", "throng", "surrounding", "depicting", "among", "nearby", "quite", "curls", "without" }
inspector.checkRoom = function(callback)
local results = {} local wordsChecked = {} local newWords = {}
for idx, word in ipairs(inspector.ignoreWords) do wordsChecked[word] = true end
local words, skippedWords = inspector.parseText(tfe.roomInfo.description)
-- add a blank search! so we get the oldern days results table.insert(words, ' ')
-- local words = inspector.parseText("The sound of the east lapping a wall") local co
-- display(words)
co = coroutine.create(function()
while #words > 0 do
local word = string.lower(table.remove(words))
if not wordsChecked[word] then
table.insert(newWords, word)
cecho('\n<green>INSPECTOR<white>: checking ' .. word)
inspector.checkWord(word, function(result)
if (word == nil or rex.match(word, [[^\s*$]])) then result = result or {} result.look = nil end
-- display(word, result) wordsChecked[word] = true results[word] = result
if (result and result.look) then -- display('saw something -- adding new words!!!')
local newWords, newSkipped = inspector.parseText(result.look)
for idx, newWord in ipairs(newWords) do if not wordsChecked[newWord] then table.insert(words, newWord) end end
for idx, newSkip in ipairs(newSkipped) do if not table.contains(skippedWords, newSkip) then table.insert(skippedWords, newSkip) end end -- display(newWords)
end
coroutine.resume(co) end)
coroutine.yield() end
end
cecho('\n<white>Inspected: ') for _, word in ipairs(newWords) do if (not results[word]) then -- cechoLink('<green><u>' .. word .. '<reset>', function() inspector.ignoreWord(word) end, 'ignore this word in future searches', true) cecho('<green><u>' .. word .. '<reset>') cecho(' ') end end
cecho('\n<white>Skipped: ') for _, word in ipairs(skippedWords) do if (not results[word]) then cecho('<green><u>' .. word .. '<reset>') -- cechoLink('<green><u>' .. word .. '<reset>', function() inspector.ignoreWord(word) end, 'ignore this word in future searches', true) cecho(' ') end end
results = inspector.condense(results)
-- display(results)
setRoomUserData(tfe.roomInfo.num, "inspectResult", yajl.to_string(results))
-- callback(results) inspector.displayInspectResults()
if (callback) then callback() end
end)
coroutine.resume(co)
end
inspector.resetManualSearch = function() clearRoomUserDataItem(tfe.roomInfo.num, "manualSearch") end
inspector.addManualSearch = function(cmd) local results = getRoomUserData(tfe.roomInfo.num, "manualSearch")
if results == '' then results = '{}' end
results = yajl.to_value(results)
table.insert(results, cmd)
setRoomUserData(tfe.roomInfo.num, "manualSearch", yajl.to_string(results))
display(results)
end
inspector.inspectUninspected = function(cb)
if (#table.keys(murder.exits) > 0) then cecho('\n<orange>INSPECTOR<white>: skipping scan due to adjacent mobs\n') cb() return end
local results = getRoomUserData(tfe.roomInfo.num, "inspectResult")
if (results and results ~= "") then cb() else inspector.checkRoom(cb) end
end
inspector.displayInspectResults = function()
local results = getRoomUserData(tfe.roomInfo.num, "inspectResult")
if (results and results ~= "") then
results = yajl.to_value(results)
if (#results.lookWords > 0) then cecho('\n<white>Inspection Results:\n') for words, text in pairs(results.look) do cecho('<green>' .. words .. '<white>:<reset> ' .. text .. '\n') end end
if (#results.searchWords > 0) then cecho('\n<white>Search Results:\n') for words, text in pairs(results.search) do cecho('<green>' .. words .. '<white>:<reset> ' .. text .. '\n') end end
if (#results.lookWords == 0 and #results.searchWords == 0) then cecho('\n<green>INSPECTOR<white>: nothing found\n\n') end
else
cecho('\n<green>INSPECTOR<white>: not yet ') cechoLink('<green><u>inspected', inspector.checkRoom, 'inspect this room', true) cecho('\n\n')
end
end
inspector.ignoreWord = function(word) if not table.contains(inspector.ignoreWords, word) then table.insert(inspector.ignoreWords, word) table.save(ignoreWordFile, inspector.ignoreWords) end end
inspector.restoreWord = function(word) if table.contains(inspector.ignoreWords, word) then table.remove(inspector.ignoreWords, table.index_of(inspector.ignoreWords, word)) table.save(ignoreWordFile, inspector.ignoreWords) end end
inspector.depluralise = function(word)
local newWord
if (inspector.dictionary[rex.gsub(word, 's$', ''):upper()]) then newWord = rex.gsub(word, 's$', '') elseif (inspector.dictionary[rex.gsub(word, 'es$', ''):upper()]) then newWord = rex.gsub(word, 'es$', '') elseif (inspector.dictionary[rex.gsub(word, 'ies$', 'y'):upper()]) then newWord = rex.gsub(word, 'ies$', '') elseif (inspector.dictionary[rex.gsub(word, 'ves$', 'f'):upper()]) then newWord = rex.gsub(word, 'ves$', '') elseif (inspector.dictionary[word:upper()]) then newWord = word end
return newWord
end
inspector.parseText = function(desc)
local skipped = {}
local words = {}
desc = rex.gsub(desc, "[^A-Za-z- ]", "") -- non word chars desc = rex.gsub(desc, "--", " ") -- double dashes. bah desc = rex.gsub(desc, [[(\S+?)-\S*]], "%1") -- single dashes followed by anything, stop at the dash desc = rex.gsub(desc, [[(?i)\b(\w|\w\w)\b]], "") -- one or two letter words desc = rex.gsub(desc, [[\s\s+]], " ") -- double+ spaces
for idx, word in ipairs(desc:split(' ')) do
local dword = inspector.depluralise(word)
if (dword) then words[dword] = true else skipped[word] = true end
end
return table.keys(words), table.keys(skipped)
end
inspector.checkWord = function(word, callback)
-- You peer around the room relentlessly. -- Nothing found matching "wallx". -- You grin. -- Whatever that is, searching it results in nothing interesting. -- You sigh.
if inspector.pendingWord then cecho('<red>INSPECTOR: <white> currently waiting for ' .. inspector.pendingWord .. ' to finish inspection') return end
inspector.pendingWord = word
local lookTrig = tempBeginOfLineTrigger("You don't know how to butcher.", function() -- deleteLine()
local initialLine = matches[1]
local lineTrig local mode = 'look'
local results = {look = {}, search = {}}
lineTrig = tempRegexTrigger([[^.*$]], function()
local line = matches[1]
if (line ~= initialLine) then
if (rex.match(line, [[^(\[ Queued|<)]])) then
-- ignore qued commands and prompts
elseif (line == 'You are not trained in the art of dissection.') then -- deleteLine() killTrigger(lineTrig) cecho('<green> <-- check done')
local hasResults = false if (results.look and not rex.match(word, [[^\s*$]])) then hasResults = true results.look = table.concat(results.look, ' ') end
if (results.search) then hasResults = true results.search = table.concat(results.search, ' ') end
inspector.pendingWord = nil
if (hasResults) then callback(results) else callback() end
elseif (line == 'You don\'t know how to track.') then -- deleteLine() mode = 'search' -- cecho('<green> <-- mode change') else
if ( rex.match(line, [[^(]] .. [[Nothing found matching ".*"|]] .. -- [[You look at .*|]] .. -- You look at the plant, but decide there are no leafs worth taking. [[You look at .* you are wielding|]] .. [[You look at [A-Z][a-z]+|]] .. [[You look at .* you are wearing|]] .. [[You look at .* you are holding|]] .. [[You look at .* floating nearby|]] .. [[To the (north|east|south|west) is .*|]] .. [[You look at .* you are carrying|]] .. [[You rummage around but find nothing interesting|]] .. [[Whatever that is, searching it results in nothing interesting)]] .. [[\.$]]) ) then results[mode] = nil -- deleteLine() -- cecho('<green> <-- ' .. mode .. ' failed' ) else
-- searches seem to come with a blank line and then a prompt before the sigh if (mode == 'search' and line == '') then mode = nil end
if (mode and results[mode]) then table.insert(results[mode], line) -- else -- deleteLine() end end
-- cecho('<green> <-- ' .. mode)
end
end
end) -- end line trig
end, 1) -- end peer trig
send('|butcher & |look ' .. word .. ' & |track & |search ' .. word .. ' & |dissect')
end
end

Script.name: player.config
Script.script:
common = common or {} player = player or {} player.scripts = player.scripts or {}
player.defaultConfig = player.defaultConfig or function ()
player.initialized = true
player.bag = 'backpack.holding' player.pack = 'black.silk.bag' player.vessel = 'leather.waterskin' player.hasFoodBasket = false player.caster = false player.gearSet = 'default'
player.getAttackCommand = function(target) return 'kill ' .. target end
player.autoAttack = function(target) send(player.getAttackCommand(target)) end
end
common.fullEnough = function()
if ((group.data[player.name].hp / group.data[player.name].hp_max) > 0.9) and ((group.data[player.name].mp / group.data[player.name].mp_max) > 0.9) and ((group.data[player.name].moves / group.data[player.name].moves_max) > 0.8) then
return true end
return false
end
common.initPlayer = function ()
echo('\n\nINITIAL STATUS CHECK\n\n')
-- rest to defaults for init
-- set extra big scrollback and fix mudlet settings setConsoleBufferSize("main", 50000, 500) setConfig('fixUnnecessaryLinebreaks', false)
common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_ABILITIES, function()
if (not gmcp.Char.Score.name) then cecho('\ngmcp not init, trying again in 2 seconds\n\n') tempTimer(2, function() common.initPlayer() end) return end
player.name = gmcp.Char.Score.name
if not (player.scripts and player.scripts[player.name]) then echo('\nSetting default player script for ' .. player.name .. '!\n') player.scripts[player.name] = player.defaultConfig end
echo('\nRunning player script for ' .. player.name .. '!\n') player.defaultConfig() player.scripts[player.name]()
njs50.ui.init()
-- cecho('\nloading gear sets. if it fails you should do "gear-save default" to save a default set\n') loadSavedGearSets()
-- load junk/loot lists inventoryManager.load()
raiseEvent(common.events.UI_LOADED)
end)
send('score & eq & group & inv & typo & prep & $abil all')
tempTimer(2, function()
if (player.gearSet['reset-set-bonuses']) then equipSet('reset-set-bonuses', function() equipSet('default') end) end
end)
end

Script.script:
njs50 = njs50 or {}
njs50.gmcp = njs50.gmcp or {}
njs50.gmcp.charReady = njs50.gmcp.charReady or false
njs50.gmcp.previous = njs50.gmcp.previous or {}
njs50.gmcp.convertRecord = function (record) return { mp_max = record.maxen, mp = record.en, moves_max = record.maxmv, hp = record.hp, hp_max = record.maxhp, moves = record.mv, race = record.race, } end
njs50.gmcp.triggerUpdatePlayerGroup = function()
if (not njs50.gmcp.nextUpdate or njs50.gmcp.nextUpdate < getEpoch() ) then njs50.gmcp.nextUpdate = getEpoch() + 0.05 tempTimer(0.05, function() -- cecho('<-- <green>gmcp') njs50.gmcp.updatePlayerGroup() njs50.gmcp.nextUpdate = nil end) else -- cecho('<-- <orange>debounced') end
end
njs50.gmcp.updatePlayerGroup = function()
if (not gmcp.Char or not gmcp.Char.Score or not gmcp.Char.Score.name or not gmcp.Char.Vitals or not gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmv) then -- gmcp is not ready enough to update player and group cecho('\n<orange>GMCP<white>: attempted to update player and group before gmcp was ready\n') return end
-- if (njs50.gmcp.pendingUpdatePlayerGroup) then -- cecho('\n<orange>GMCP<white>: attempted to update player and group while update was pending\n') -- return -- end
-- njs50.gmcp.pendingUpdatePlayerGroup = true
-- debouncing gmcp update because it gets triggered twice by Char and Group -- especially solo, char.moves and Group.min_moves changes each room -- tempTimer(0.075, function() -- njs50.gmcp.pendingUpdatePlayerGroup = nil
local playerStats = njs50.gmcp.convertRecord(gmcp.Char.Vitals)
group.leader = gmcp.Char.Score.name group.looter = '' group.lowest_moves = gmcp.Char.Vitals.mv
group.memberCount = 1
group.members = {[gmcp.Char.Score.name] = true} group.data = {[gmcp.Char.Score.name] = playerStats}
for stat, val in pairs(playerStats) do player[stat] = val end
if (gmcp.Group and #table.keys(gmcp.Group) > 0) then
group.leader = gmcp.Group.leader group.looter = gmcp.Group.looter group.lowest_moves = gmcp.Group.minmv
group.memberCount = 1 + #table.keys(gmcp.Group.members)
for name, stats in pairs(gmcp.Group.members) do group.members[name] = true group.data[name] = njs50.gmcp.convertRecord(stats) end
end
-- cecho('<green> <-- gmcp update') raiseEvent(common.events.PARSED_GMCP_GROUP); -- end, 'delayed gmcp player/group update')
end

Script.name: njs50.gmcp.charUpdate
Script.script:
njs50.gmcp.charUpdate = function()
if (#table.keys(gmcp.Char) == 0 or not gmcp.Char.Score or not gmcp.Char.Score.name) then cecho('\n<yellow>njs50-tfe<white>: gmcp.Char updated with no data\n') return end
-- delay any processing until enough gmcp char data has been recieved if (not njs50.gmcp.charReady) then
if (gmcp.Char.Score and gmcp.Char.Status and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Score and gmcp.Char.Status and gmcp.Char.Score.name) then njs50.gmcp.charReady = true
-- invoke old code previously trigged via first prompt cecho('<green>njs50-tfe<white>: gmcp ready - initializing char\n')
player.initPending = true common.initPlayer() njs50.gmcp.triggerUpdatePlayerGroup() end
else
-- cecho('<green> <-- char updated ')
if (njs50.tableHasValueChanges(gmcp.Char.Vitals, njs50.gmcp.previous.Vitals)) then
njs50.gmcp.previous.Vitals = table.deepcopy(gmcp.Char.Vitals) -- cecho('<green> <-- vitals updated (gmcp.char) ')
njs50.gmcp.triggerUpdatePlayerGroup()
end
end
end

Script.name: njs50.gmcp.groupUpdate
Script.script:
njs50.gmcp.groupUpdate = function ()
if (#table.keys(gmcp.Group) == 0) then cecho('\n<yellow>njs50-tfe<white>: gmcp.Group updated with no data\n') return end
if (njs50.tableHasValueChanges(gmcp.Group, njs50.gmcp.previous.Group)) then
njs50.gmcp.previous.Group = table.deepcopy(gmcp.Group)
njs50.gmcp.triggerUpdatePlayerGroup()
end
end

Script.name: channel.update
Script.script:
channel = channel or {}
channel.seq = channel.seq or {}
local chatTabs = { Gossip = 'Public', OOC = 'Public', UC = 'Public', ATALK = 'Public', Yell = 'Public', Newbie = 'Public', Ctell = 'Clan', Tell = 'Tell', Cstatus = nil, Gtell = 'Group', Gstatus = nil, Log = 'Log', Other = 'Other', }
channel.update = function()
if (#table.keys(gmcp.Channels) == 0) then cecho('\n<yellow>njs50-tfe<white>: gmcp.Channels updated with no data\n') return end
for chan, status in pairs(gmcp.Channels) do
if (channel.seq[chan] == nil or channel.seq[chan] ~= status.sequence) then channel.seq[chan] = status.sequence
if (chatTabs[chan]) then -- local excludeAll = false
if chan == 'Tell' and rex.find(status.message, [[^(do |light|time|repopped|location:|ee-only |ee-only-single |ee |ack:|running command)]]) then chan = 'Log' excludeAll = true end
if (chan == 'Yell' and (status.language == 'unknown' or status.language == 'primal')) then chan = 'Other' excludeAll = true end
local message = '[' .. chan .. '] ' .. status.who .. ': ' .. status.message common.consoleMessage(chatTabs[chan], message, 'green', excludeAll)
end
end
end
end

Script.name: tfe.char_fighting
Script.script:
-- combat tracking via gmcp too unreliable for non tanks
tfe = tfe or {}
tfe.char_fighting = function ()
local hasTarget = false
local fighting = gmcp.Char.Fighting or {}
-- display(gmcp.Char.Fighting) local firstTarget
local count = 0
for mob, state in pairs(gmcp.Char.Fighting) do count = count + 1 if not firstTarget then firstTarget = mob end if (state.target == true) then hasTarget = true end end
combat.mobs = count
if (count == 0 and combat.active) then
if (combat.finshDelayTimer ~= nil) then killTimer(combat.finshDelayTimer) combat.finshDelayTimer = nil end
combat.finishPending = true
-- rabies: when not the group leader we leave combat between one mob dying -- and auto.assist making us hit the next mob. gmcp.Char.Fighting only -- has the mob we are currently fighting, not all the mobs in this case
local combatFinishDelay = 1
-- rabies: seems like tanks might also get a gap between fights
if (gmcp.Char.Score.name == gmcp.Group.leader) then combatFinishDelay = 0.1 end
combat.finshDelayTimer = tempTimer(combatFinishDelay, function() combat.finish() combat.finshDelayTimer = nil combat.finishPending = nil end)
elseif (count > 0) then
if (combat.finshDelayTimer ~= nil) then killTimer(combat.finshDelayTimer) combat.finshDelayTimer = nil end
if (not combat.active) then combat.start() end
if not hasTarget then
-- rabies: removing articles because "an illithid" seems to be broken firstTarget = rex.gsub(firstTarget,[[^(\d+\.)(a|an|the)\.(.+$)]],'%1%3')
cecho('\n<green>COMBAT<white>: in combat without a target, attacking - ' .. firstTarget .. '\n')
send(player.getAttackCommand(firstTarget)) end
end
end

Script.name: njs50.gmcp.fightingUpdate
Script.script:
njs50.gmcp.previous.mobs = njs50.gmcp.previous.mobs or {} njs50.gmcp.previous.target = njs50.gmcp.previous.target or ''
-- FIGHTING_TARGET_UPDATE
njs50.gmcp.fightingUpdate = function()
if (njs50.tableHasValueChanges(gmcp.Char.Fighting, njs50.gmcp.previous.fighting)) then
-- cecho('<green> <-- gmcp.Char.Fighting updated ') njs50.gmcp.previous.fighting = table.deepcopy(gmcp.Char.Fighting)
raiseEvent(common.events.FIGHTING_UPDATE, gmcp.Char.Fighting) -- display('fite update', gmcp.Char.Fighting)
local mobs = table.keys(gmcp.Char.Fighting) local adds = table.n_complement(mobs, njs50.gmcp.previous.mobs)
-- need to have been in combat already for these to be adds if (#adds > 0 and #njs50.gmcp.previous.mobs > 0) then raiseEvent(common.events.MOBS_JOINED_COMBAT, adds) end
njs50.gmcp.previous.mobs = mobs
-- check for target changes local target = '' for mob, data in pairs(gmcp.Char.Fighting) do if data.target then target = mob end end
if target ~= njs50.gmcp.previous.target then raiseEvent(common.events.FIGHTING_TARGET_UPDATE, target) njs50.gmcp.previous.target = target end
end
end

Script.name: player.affect_change
Script.script:
player = player or {} group = group or {} group.needsFix = group.needsFix or {}
player.needsStatusFix = player.needsStatusFix or {} player.affect_change = function()
local add = function(spell) local target = gmcp.Char.Score.name group.needsFix[target] = group.needsFix[target] or {} if not table.contains(group.needsFix[target], spell) then table.insert(group.needsFix[target], spell) end end
local remove = function(spell) local target = gmcp.Char.Score.name if group.needsFix[target] and table.contains(group.needsFix[target], spell) then table.remove(group.needsFix[target], table.index_of(group.needsFix[target], spell)) if #group.needsFix[target] == 0 then group.needsFix[target] = nil end end end
-- need purify if (generic.hasAffect('confuse', true) or generic.hasAffect('curse', true) or generic.hasAffect('slow', true)) then
if (not player.needsStatusFix['purify']) then player.needsStatusFix['purify'] = true add('purify') send('gstat ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name .. ' desires purify') end
elseif player.needsStatusFix['purify'] then player.needsStatusFix['purify'] = nil remove('purify') send('gstat ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name .. ' has had enough purify') end
-- need neutralize if (generic.hasAffect('hallucinate', true) or generic.hasAffect('silence', true) or generic.hasAffect('acidic venom', true)) then if (not player.needsStatusFix['neutralize']) then player.needsStatusFix['neutralize'] = true add('neutralize') send('gstat ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name .. ' desires neutralize') end
elseif player.needsStatusFix['neutralize'] then
player.needsStatusFix['neutralize'] = nil remove('neutralize') send('gstat ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name .. ' has had enough neutralize')
end
-- need cb if (generic.hasAffect('blind', true)) then if (not player.needsStatusFix['cure blind']) then player.needsStatusFix['cure blind'] = true add('cure blind') send('gstat ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name .. ' desires cure blind') end
elseif player.needsStatusFix['cure blind'] then remove('cure blind') player.needsStatusFix['cure blind'] = nil send('gstat ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name .. ' has had enough cure blind')
end
-- need cb if (generic.hasAffect('poison', true)) then if (not player.needsStatusFix['cure poison']) then add('cure poison') player.needsStatusFix['cure poison'] = true send('gstat ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name .. ' desires cure poison') end
elseif player.needsStatusFix['cure poison'] then remove('cure poison') player.needsStatusFix['cure poison'] = nil send('gstat ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name .. ' has had enough cure poison')
end
end

Script.name: inventory management
Script.script:
inventoryManager = inventoryManager or {}
inventoryManager.data = inventoryManager.data or {} inventoryManager.data.itemDropList = inventoryManager.data.itemDropList or {} inventoryManager.data.containerLootList = inventoryManager.data.containerLootList or {} inventoryManager.data.saveLootList = inventoryManager.data.saveLootList or {}
inventoryManager.itemDepluralize = function(item)
local qty = rex.match(item, [[^(\d+) ]])
if qty then qty = tonumber(qty) else qty = 1 end
-- replace articles / plurals on coins etc item = rex.gsub(item, [[^(\d+) (.*) (coins)$]], '%1 %2 coin') item = rex.gsub(item, [[^(\d+) (scrolls)]], 'a scroll') item = rex.gsub(item, [[^(\d+) (empty .*) (vials)$]], '%1 %2 vial') item = rex.gsub(item, [[^(\d+) pieces of (.*)$]], '%1 piece of %2') item = rex.gsub(item, [[^(\d+) (.*)s' (skins)$]], '%1 %2\'s skin') -- 2 aurochs' skins
item = rex.gsub(item, [[^(\d+) lengths of (.*) threads$]], '%1 length of %2 thread')
-- a length of solitary purplish thread 1 .02 -- 2 lengths of solitary purplish threads
if qty > 1 then
if rex.match(item, "^\\d+ [aeiou]") then item = rex.gsub(item, [[^\d+ (.*)$]], 'an %1') else item = rex.gsub(item, [[^\d+ (.*)$]], 'a %1') end
end
-- display(item,qty)
return item, qty
end
inventoryManager.getPluralVariants = function(item)
local variants = { item }
local checkRegex = function(variants, item, regex, replacement) local newWord = rex.gsub(item, regex, replacement) if (newWord ~= item) then table.insert(variants, newWord) end end
checkRegex(variants, item, 's$', '') checkRegex(variants, item, 's of ', ' of ')
checkRegex(variants, item, '\'s ', ' ')
checkRegex(variants, item, 'es$', '') checkRegex(variants, item, 'es of ', ' of ') checkRegex(variants, item, 's filled with ', ' filled with ') checkRegex(variants, item, 's containing ', ' containing ')
checkRegex(variants, item, 'ies$', 'i') checkRegex(variants, item, 'ves$', 'f')
checkRegex(variants, item, 'staves of ', 'staff of ')
return variants
end
inventoryManager.findItemInSaveList = function(item) local variants = inventoryManager.getPluralVariants(item)
for idx, itemVariant in ipairs(variants) do
if table.contains(inventoryManager.data.saveLootList, itemVariant) then return itemVariant end
end
end
-- rabies : we need to limit how many items we can process at once
inventoryManager.depositLoot = function(cb)
tempRegexTrigger([[You look in .+ labeled loot]], function()
common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_CONTENTS, function(evt, container, contents)
common.timedTempTrigger(10, 1, [[^You can't handle]], function() cecho('\n<green>Inventory:<white> too much loot to handle -- attempting deposit again!\n') tempTimer(4, function() inventoryManager.depositLoot(cb) end, 'deposit hold') end, function() send('pl & |gstat loot deposited!') cb() end)
contents = inventoryManager.mergeInventory(contents)
local dropString = '' local tQty = 0
-- deposit loot for item, qty in pairs(contents) do
local match
item = inventoryManager.findItemInSaveList(item)
if (item and table.contains(inventoryManager.data.saveLootList, item)) then
local thisDrop
if (qty > 1) then thisDrop = tostring(qty) .. '*' .. common.dotCase(item) else thisDrop = common.dotCase(item) end
-- first item if string.len(dropString) == 0 then dropString = 'db loot all.coin,' .. thisDrop elseif string.len(dropString) + string.len(thisDrop) < 150 then dropString = dropString .. ',' .. thisDrop else expandAlias(dropString) dropString = 'db loot ' .. thisDrop end
end
end
if (dropString ~= '') then expandAlias(dropString) end
send('|deposit all.coin & |with 100090')
end)
end, 1)
send('gl & |look in loot')
end
inventoryManager.load = function()
local fn = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/inventory.dat"
local is_file = io.open(fn)
local data = {}
if (is_file ~= nil) then table.load(fn, inventoryManager.data) cecho('\n<green>Inventory:<white> configuration loaded\n') end
end
inventoryManager.save = function()
local fn = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/inventory.dat"
table.save(fn, inventoryManager.data) cecho('\n<green>Inventory:<white> configuration saved\n')
end
inventoryManager.debouncedSave = function() generic.debounceTimer('inventory manager save', 45, inventoryManager.save) end
inventoryManager.mergeInventory = function(inventory) local items = {} inventory = inventory or {} for item, qty in pairs(inventory) do local mergedItem = rex.gsub(item, [[(slightly rusty,? |very rusty,? |rusty,? |slightly tarnished,? |very tarnished,? |tarnished,? )]], '')
-- removed empty from this list so we can drop empty things specifically mergedItem = rex.gsub(mergedItem, [[(\+chaotic\+,? |\+lawful\+,? |\+evil\+,? |\+good\+,? |thanatotic,? |acid-dripping,? |divinely flamed,? |enchanted,? |closed,? |spiteful,? |jinxing,? |flaming,? |labeled )]], '')
mergedItem = rex.gsub(mergedItem, [[(^an? )]], '')
items[mergedItem] = items[mergedItem] or 0 items[mergedItem] = items[mergedItem] + qty end return items end
inventoryManager.getMergedInventory = function(cb) generic.getInventory(function(inventory) cb(inventoryManager.mergeInventory(inventory)) end) end
-- setup a user window for inventory management inventoryManager.popup = inventoryManager.popup or Geyser.UserWindow:new({ name="Inventory Manager" })
inventoryManager.popup:setFont(getFont()) inventoryManager.popup:setFontSize(getFontSize()) inventoryManager.popup:resize("120c","30c") inventoryManager.popup:hide()
inventoryManager.showDropList = function() inventoryManager.showList(inventoryManager.data.itemDropList, inventoryManager.data.itemDropList, 'auto drop', inventoryManager.showDropList) end
inventoryManager.showJunkContainers = function() inventoryManager.showList(inventoryManager.data.containerLootList, inventoryManager.data.containerLootList, 'auto loot then drop containers', inventoryManager.showJunkContainers) end
inventoryManager.showSaveLootList = function() inventoryManager.showList(inventoryManager.data.saveLootList, inventoryManager.data.saveLootList, 'auto save loot', inventoryManager.showSaveLootList) end
inventoryManager.flagInventoryJunk = function() inventoryManager.getMergedInventory(function(inventory) inventoryManager.showList(table.keys(inventory), inventoryManager.data.itemDropList, 'auto drop', inventoryManager.flagInventoryJunk) end) end
inventoryManager.flagJunkContainers = function() inventoryManager.getMergedInventory(function(inventory) inventoryManager.showList(table.keys(inventory), inventoryManager.data.containerLootList, 'auto loot then drop container', inventoryManager.flagJunkContainers) end) end
inventoryManager.flagSaveLootList = function() inventoryManager.getMergedInventory(function(inventory) inventoryManager.showList(table.keys(inventory), inventoryManager.data.saveLootList, 'auto save loot', inventoryManager.flagSaveLootList) end) end
inventoryManager.showList = function(allItems, selectedItems, listName, onUpdate)
inventoryManager.popup:clear() inventoryManager.popup:show()
inventoryManager.popup:cecho('\n<green>Inventory:<white> Items marked for ' .. listName .. '\n')
table.sort(allItems)
for idx, item in ipairs(allItems) do
if not table.contains(selectedItems, item) then
inventoryManager.popup:cechoLink(demonnic:cfText('<green>' .. item .. '<reset>', {alignment = "left", width = 50, nogap=true}), function()
if not table.contains(selectedItems, item) then table.insert(selectedItems, item) if type(onUpdate) == 'function' then onUpdate() inventoryManager.debouncedSave() end end
end, "add item to " .. listName, true) else inventoryManager.popup:cechoLink(demonnic:cfText('<red>' .. item .. '<reset>', {alignment = "left", width = 50, nogap=true}), function() if table.contains(selectedItems, item) then table.remove(selectedItems, table.index_of(selectedItems,item)) if type(onUpdate) == 'function' then onUpdate() inventoryManager.debouncedSave() end end end, "remove item from " .. listName, true) end
if idx % 2 == 0 then inventoryManager.popup:cecho('\n') end
end
end

Script.name: inventoryManager.stowItems
Script.script:
player = player or {}
player.keepInPack = player.keepInPack or {}
-- player.keepInPack = { -- ["a spotted cheetah skin"] = true, -- ["a shadowy rod"] = true, -- ["a feather-tipped rod"] = true, -- ["a pearl"] = true, -- ["a feathered talisman"] = true, -- ["a multicoloured belt of the elements"] = true, -- ["a cottonwood rod of presage"] = true, -- ["a dowsing stick"] = true, -- ["a soft, snow-white bear skin"] = true, -- ["a shadowbox"] = true -- }
inventoryManager.stowItems = function(evt, data)
local moveItems = {}
-- "a soft, snow-white bear skin"
for item, qty in pairs(player.inventory) do
-- ffs. "a poop might" become "an enchanted poop" if you are detecting magic item = common.itemSanitize(item)
altItem = rex.gsub(item, [[^an? ]], 'a ')
if (player.keepInPack[item] or player.keepInPack[altItem]) then
-- lua common.itemShorten("a soft, snow-white bear skin") local itemStr = ''

Script.name: inventoryManager.manageInventory
Script.script:
inventoryManager = inventoryManager or {}
inventoryManager.itemDotCase = function(item) return common.dotCase(rex.gsub(item, "[^A-Za-z-' ]", '')) end
inventoryManager.manageInventory = function(_evt, inventory)
-- cecho('\n<green>INVENTORY:<white> inventory was parsed, checking...\n')
local timeSeconds = os.time()
if (inventoryManager.lockoutUntil and inventoryManager.lockoutUntil > timeSeconds) then cecho('\n<orange>INVENTORY:<white> inventory management skipped due to recent check\n') return end
inventoryManager.lockoutUntil = timeSeconds + 3
inventory = inventoryManager.mergeInventory(inventory)
local savedItems = {}
-- put loot away first (esp since we could have black.cloaks.of.power in keep list and black.cloak in the rubbish list for item, qty in pairs(inventory) do
if (table.contains(inventoryManager.data.saveLootList, item)) then local thisItem = '' if (qty > 1) then thisItem = tostring(qty) .. '*' .. inventoryManager.itemDotCase(item) else thisItem = inventoryManager.itemDotCase(item) end table.insert(savedItems, thisItem) end
end
if (#savedItems > 0) then send('gl') send('put ' .. table.concat(savedItems, ',') .. ' loot') send('pl') end
local dropString = ''
-- auto appraise (gems) if (player and player.skills and player.skills.appraise and player.skills.appraise > 1) then for item, qty in pairs(inventory) do if (rex.match(item, [[ gem$]])) then -- gem detected! local thisDrop = inventoryManager.itemDotCase(item)
for idx=qty,1,-1 do send('|appraise ' .. tostring(idx) .. '.' .. thisDrop .. ' & |drop fake.gem') end
end end end
-- drop junk for item, qty in pairs(inventory) do
if (table.contains(inventoryManager.data.itemDropList, item)) then
local thisDrop
if (qty > 1) then thisDrop = tostring(qty) .. '*' .. inventoryManager.itemDotCase(item) else thisDrop = inventoryManager.itemDotCase(item) end
local action = 'drop ' if ( inventoryManager.junkOnNextCheck) then action = 'junk ' inventoryManager.junkOnNextCheck = nil end
-- first item if string.len(dropString) == 0 then dropString = action .. thisDrop elseif string.len(dropString) + string.len(thisDrop) < 300 then dropString = dropString .. ',' .. thisDrop else send(dropString) dropString = action .. thisDrop end
end
end
if (dropString ~= '') then send(dropString) end
-- containers to auto loot nb: this might make more junk for item, qty in pairs(inventory) do if table.contains(inventoryManager.data.containerLootList, item) then
for i=qty, 1, -1 do send('|label ' .. i .. '.' .. inventoryManager.itemDotCase(item) .. ' as xTemp') send('|open xTemp & |get all xTemp & |label xTemp') -- send('|drop empty.' .. common.dotCase(item)) end
end end
end

Script.name: bag aliases
Script.script:
-- player.bagLocation = {'xGear', 'loot', 'xThree', 'xTwo', 'xOne', 'xMoyrath'} -- player.lootBagLocation = {'loot', 'xThree', 'xTwo', 'xOne', 'xMoyrath' }
inventoryManager.getBagCmd = function(loc) local cmds = {} for i = #loc, 2, -1 do table.insert(cmds, '|get ' .. loc[i-1] .. ' from ' .. loc[i]) end return table.concat(cmds, ' & ') end
inventoryManager.putBagCmd = function(loc) local cmds = {} for i = 1, #loc-1 do table.insert(cmds, '|put ' .. loc[i] .. ' in ' .. loc[i+1]) end return table.concat(cmds, ' & ') end
inventoryManager.createBagAliases = function() send('alias *gs ' .. inventoryManager.getBagCmd(player.bagLocation)) send('alias *ps ' .. inventoryManager.putBagCmd(player.bagLocation)) send('alias *gl ' .. inventoryManager.getBagCmd(player.lootBagLocation)) send('alias *pl ' .. inventoryManager.putBagCmd(player.lootBagLocation)) end

Script.name: njs50.on_UI_loaded
Script.script:
njs50 = njs50 or {}
-- do some initialization stuff here. njs50.on_UI_loaded = function()
-- disable trigger groups that shouldnt' be enabled disableTrigger('mage-sleep-plev')
local classes = { 'druid', 'mage', 'cleric', 'paladin', 'warrior', 'thief', 'harbinger', 'reaver', 'legate', 'bard', 'ranger', 'monk' }
local thisClass = gmcp.Char.Score.class
for idx, class in ipairs(classes) do if class ~= thisClass then disableTrigger('njs50-' .. class) disableAlias('njs50-' .. class) disableScript('njs50-' .. class) disableTimer('njs50-' .. class) end end
