end

Script.name: combat
Script.script:
------------------------------------------------- -- Put your Lua functions here. -- -- -- -- Note that you can also use external Scripts -- ------------------------------------------------- combat = combat or { active = false, mobCount = 0, pendingMobCount = 0, mobs = {}, pendingMobs = {}, clear_timer = nil, sleeping_mob = false }
combat.roomClearDelay = 5
-- starting a 4 sec timer to make sure nothing else -- wants to get fighty before declaring the room clear combat.startTimer = function (delayoverride) local delay = delayoverride or combat.roomClearDelay if(combat.clear_timer) then -- cecho('<yellow><-- restarting room clear timer\n') combat.clearTimer() end -- cecho('<yellow><-- setting room clear timer for ' .. tostring(delay) .. 's\n') combat.clear_timer = tempTimer(delay, function() combat.clear_timer = nil -- cecho('<yellow><-- running on room clear\n') combat.onRoomClear() end, 'combat clear timer') end
combat.onRoomClear = function () -- cecho('<green><-- room is clear ...\n')
-- room isn't really clear if an attack is pending. restart timer... if (player.pendingAttack) then cecho('<green><-- room is not clear?? expecting combat to start?\n') return combat.startTimer() end
combat.clearTimer() if (murder.enabled and player.position == 'standing') then murder.scan('room clear') end -- cecho('<green><-- CLEAR (no combat for ' .. tostring(combat.roomClearDelay) .. ' seconds)!!! \n') raiseEvent(common.events.ROOM_CLEAR) end
combat.clearTimer = function() if (combat.clear_timer) then -- cecho('<yellow><-- room clear timer cancelled ...\n') killTimer(combat.clear_timer) end combat.clear_timer = nil end
combat.reset = function() -- cecho('<yellow><-- room found - reseting combat timer\n') combat.startTimer() combat.active = false combat.mobCount = 0 combat.mobs = {} combat.pendingMobCount = 0 combat.pendingMobs = {} end
combat.extendRoomCheck = function ()
if (combat.clear_timer) then -- cecho('<green><-- EXTEND ROOM CLEAR CHECK\n') combat.clearTimer() end
combat.startTimer()
end
combat.start = function()
if (not combat.active) then combat.startTime = getEpoch() combat.active = true common.log(' <white><-- -=[ COMBAT started ]=-') raiseEvent(common.events.COMBAT_STARTED) combat.clearTimer() end
end
combat.finish = function (reason)
if (combat.active) then combat.active = false common.log(' <white> -=[ combat ended ]=-') if (group.leader == player.name) then -- don't rescan on sleep and trigger us sleeping the mob again... if (reason == nil or reason ~= 'sleep') then murder.scan('combat ended') else common.log('<green><-- skipped scan because mob left due to sleep\n') end else common.log('<green><-- skipped scan due to not being leader\n') end
raiseEvent(common.events.COMBAT_ENDED, getEpoch() - combat.startTime) combat.startTimer() end
end
combat.roomChanged = function() combat.reset() end
combat.roomClear = function()
combat.clearTimer()
combat.mobCount = combat.mobCount or 0
if (combat.mobCount > 0) then common.log('<green><-- room is clear but we think there are mobs here still\n') -- display(combat) if (combat.active) then combat.finish('room appears to be clear') end end
-- murder.scan('room appears to be clear')
end
combat.mobJoined = function(mob) common.log('<green><-- mob add ' .. mob .. '\n')
combat.mobs[mob] = combat.mobs[mob] or 0 combat.mobs[mob] = combat.mobs[mob] + 1 combat.mobCount = combat.mobCount + 1 -- display(combat.mobs) if (combat.pendingMobs[mob] and combat.pendingMobs[mob] > 0) then combat.pendingMobs[mob] = combat.pendingMobs[mob] - 1 combat.pendingMobCount = combat.pendingMobCount - 1 end
-- make sure combat.mobs is correct before triggering combat start and mob joined event combat.start() raiseEvent(common.events.MOB_JOINED_COMBAT, mob) end
combat.mobJoinPending = function(mob) common.log('<green><-- mob join pending ' .. mob .. '\n') combat.pendingMobs = combat.pendingMobs or {} combat.pendingMobs[mob] = combat.pendingMobs[mob] or 0 combat.pendingMobs[mob] = combat.pendingMobs[mob] + 1 combat.pendingMobCount = (combat.pendingMobCount or 0) + 1 raiseEvent(common.events.MOB_ENTERED_ROOM, mob) end
combat.mobJoinNotPending = function(mob) common.log('<green><-- mob canceled pending join ' .. mob .. '\n') combat.pendingMobs = combat.pendingMobs or {} combat.pendingMobs[mob] = combat.pendingMobs[mob] or 0 if combat.pendingMobs[mob] > 0 then combat.pendingMobs[mob] = combat.pendingMobs[mob] - 1 combat.pendingMobCount = combat.pendingMobCount - 1 end raiseEvent(common.events.MOB_LEFT_ROOM, mob) end
combat.mobLeft = function(mob, reason) common.log('<green><-- mob left ' .. mob .. '\n') -- it's possible a mob could die who hasn't started combat yet if (combat.mobs[mob]) then combat.mobs[mob] = combat.mobs[mob] - 1 if (combat.mobs[mob] == 0) then combat.mobs[mob] = nil end combat.mobCount = combat.mobCount - 1
if (combat.mobCount == 0) then combat.finish(reason) else combat.extendRoomCheck() end else common.log('<orange>COMBAT:<white> mob left combat that hadn\'t joined: ' .. mob .. '\n') combat.mobJoinNotPending(mob) if (combat.mobCount == 0) then combat.finish(reason) else combat.extendRoomCheck() end end
raiseEvent(common.events.MOB_LEFT_COMBAT, mob)
end
combat.mobBlockedExit = function(mob, direction) combat.pendingMobs[mob] = combat.pendingMobs[mob] or 0 combat.pendingMobs[mob] = combat.pendingMobs[mob] + 1 combat.pendingMobCount = combat.pendingMobCount + 1 raiseEvent(common.events.MOB_BLOCKED_EXIT, mob, direction) end

Script.name: combat.something_hit
Script.script:
combat.something_hit = function(evt, attackData)
-- display(attackData, combat.active)
if attackData.mob ~= "" and (not combat.active) and group.members[attackData.subject] then local mob = string.lower(attackData.mob):gsub(' ','.') combat.mobJoinPending(mob) -- event now raised here to ensure correct stats combat.start() end
-- combat.extendRoomCheckThrottle = -- combat.extendRoomCheck
end

Script.name: make-food-drink
Script.script:
caster = caster or {}
caster.createWater = function(vessel, cb, fcb)
local notWaterTrig local createdWaterTrig local createdWaterTimer
local clearTrigs = function()
if (notWaterTrig) then killTrigger(notWaterTrig) notWaterTrig = nil end
if (createdWaterTrig) then killTrigger(createdWaterTrig) createdWaterTrig = nil end end
createdWaterTrig = tempRegexTrigger([[^An? ]] .. vessel .. [[ fills to overflowing with (.*)\.$]], function() if (matches[2]) == 'water' then clearTrigs() cb() else send('empty all.' .. common.dotCase(vessel)) send('cast create water ' .. common.dotCase(vessel)) end end)
notWaterTrig = tempRegexTrigger([[^(<[^>]+>)?You can only cast create water on a drink container\.$]], function() clearTrigs() fcb() end)
send('cast create water ' .. common.dotCase(vessel))
end

Script.name: status checks / prep
Script.script:
------------------------------------------------- -- Put your Lua functions here. -- -- -- -- Note that you can also use external Scripts -- -------------------------------------------------
common.getAffects = function (cb) common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_AFFECTS, function (evt, affects) cb(affects) end) send('|affects') end
common.onClear = function(action) common.onNextEvent(common.events.ROOM_CLEAR, action) end
common.onNewRoomClear = function(action)
local e1, e2
-- in case something fights us before we change rooms -- accept the room clear event after that. e2 = common.onNextEvent(common.events.COMBAT_ENDED, function() e1() e2 = common.onNextEvent(common.events.ROOM_CLEAR, action) end)
-- otherwise wait for the room to change, then the room clear event e1 = common.onNextEvent(tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED, function() e2() e1 = common.onNextEvent(common.events.ROOM_CLEAR, action) end)
return function() e1() e2() end
end
common.onCombat = function(action) common.onNextEvent(common.events.COMBAT_STARTED, action) end
common.getRepertoire = function(cb) common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_REPERTOIRE, function (evt, repertoire) cb(repertoire) end) send('repertoire') end
common.repertoireEnableAll = function() common.repertoireChangeAll(true) end
common.repertoireDisableAll = function() common.repertoireChangeAll(false) end
common.repertoireChangeAll = function(setEnabled) common.getRepertoire(function(oRep) for skill, enabled in pairs(oRep) do if (not enabled and setEnabled == true) then send('repertoire ' .. skill) elseif (enabled and setEnabled == false) then send('repertoire ' .. skill) end end end) end
common.onQueueCleared = njs50.onEmptyQueue
common.checkShields = function (cbGood, cbBad)
-- Affect Source -- -- ------ ------ -- You sense a divine protection. leech: a male vyan -- You feel righteous. leech: a male vyan
local affectWatcher = nil
local tempAffects = false local affectCount = 0
local okayTempAffects = { ['You feel sick!'] = true, ['Your battlemind is divinely focused.'] = true, ['You are embraced by earthen protection.'] = true, }
common.getAffects( function (affects)
for affect, source in pairs(affects) do
if (source == 'temporary') then -- earthen protection is always tempporary if not okayTempAffects[affect] then cecho('<white>--== <red>expiring : ' .. affect .. ' <white> =-\n') tempAffects = true end
end affectCount = affectCount + 1
end
if (tempAffects) then cecho('\n<red>WARNING: <white>Affects Checked!, some shields will expire!\n') if (cbBad) then cbBad(player.affects) end else cecho('\n<green>Affects Checked!, ' .. tostring(affectCount) .. ' affects are good\n') if (cbGood) then cbGood(player.affects) end end
end)
end

Script.name: swap
Script.script:
------------------------------------------------- -- Put your Lua functions here. -- -- -- -- Note that you can also use external Scripts -- ------------------------------------------------- local maxLength = 80
gear = gear or {}
player = player or {}
player.swapItems = player.swapItems or {} player.gearSets = player.gearSets or {}
common.conditions = { worthless = 0, damaged = 1, ["very worn"] = 2, worn = 3, ["very scratched"] = 4, ["very scratch"] = 4, scratched = 5, reasonable = 6, good = 7, ["very good"] = 8, excellent = 9, perfect = 10 }
common.slots = { "right hand", "left hand", "left hand finger", "right hand finger", "right wrist", "left wrist", "head", "body", "nearby", "arms", "hands", "feet", "legs", "waist", "neck" }
common.layers = { 'bottom', 'under', 'base', 'over', 'top' }
common.lowestGearIgnore = { ["powdered wig"] = true, ["golden ball of light"] = true, ["pale feather of a hieracosphinx"] = true, }
common.shiftingItems = { ['orange.strip'] = {'orange.headband','orange.strip'}, ['shif.blac.shor'] = {'shif.blac.shor', 'shif.blac.sabr'}, ['cloa.prot'] = {'cloa.prot', 'cloa.grea.prot', 'cloa.supe.prot'}, ['cloak of protection'] = {'cloak of protection', 'cloak of greater protection', 'cloak of superior protection'}, ['shifting black shortspear'] = {'shifting black shortspear', 'shifting black sabre'}, }
common.getWeaponCondition = function(cb) common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_EQUIPMENT, function() if not (player.gear["right hand"] and player.gear["right hand"].base) then cb(common.conditions['perfect']) else cb(common.conditions[player.gear["right hand"].base.condition]) end
end) send('|eq')
end
function getLowestGearCondition (cb) common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_EQUIPMENT, function() -- lua player.gear["right hand"].base.condition local lowestCondition = 11 local lowestItem
for slot, layers in pairs(player.gear) do for layer, item in pairs(layers) do if (common.conditions[item.condition] == nil) then cecho('\n\n<red>[GEAR]: <white> unknown gear condition: ' .. item.condition .. '\n\n') else if (not common.lowestGearIgnore[item.item] and common.conditions[item.condition] < lowestCondition) then lowestCondition = common.conditions[item.condition] lowestItem = item end end end end -- display(lowestItem) -- display(player.gear) cb(lowestCondition) end) send('|eq') end
function gearSets() cecho('\n<green>GEAR:<white> saved sets:\n\n') for set, deets in spairs(player.gearSets) do cecho(set .. '\n') end end
common.standIfSleeping = function()
local sleeping = gmcp.Char.Status.position == 'sleeping'
if (sleeping) then send('stand') end
return sleeping
end
function equipSet(set, callback, showDiffOnly) if (player.gearSets[set]) then
common.standIfSleeping()
if (showDiffOnly ~= true) then player.gearSet = set send('gs') end
equipGearSet(set, function() if (showDiffOnly ~= true) then send('ps') end if callback then callback() end end, nil, showDiffOnly)
else cecho('\n<red>GEAR: <white>No set found matching: "' .. set .. '"\n') end end
function equipPartial(set, callback, showDiffOnly) if (player.gearSets[set]) then
common.standIfSleeping()
cecho('\n<green>GEAR: <white>Equip partial set: "' .. set .. '"\n') if (showDiffOnly ~= true) then send('gs') end equipGearSet(set, function() if (showDiffOnly ~= true) then send('ps') end if callback then callback() end end, true, showDiffOnly)
else cecho('\n<red>GEAR: <white>No set found matching: "' .. set .. '"\n') end end
function resetGear(callback)
if (player.gearSets[player.gearSet]) then
common.standIfSleeping()
cecho('\n<green>GEAR: <white>resetting gear to set: "' .. player.gearSet .. '"\n') send('gs', true)
equipGearSet(player.gearSet, function() send('ps', true) if callback then callback() end end)
else cecho('\n<red>GEAR: <white>No set found matching: "' .. player.gearSet .. '"\n') end end
function deleteGearSet (name) table.save(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/gearsets.backup.dat", player.gearSets) player.gearSets[name] = nil table.save(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/gearsets.dat", player.gearSets) end
function saveGearSet (name, callback)
common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_EQUIPMENT, function() table.save(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/gearsets.backup.dat", player.gearSets) player.gearSets[name] = player.gear table.save(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/gearsets.dat", player.gearSets) if (callback) then callback() end end) send('|eq')
end
function loadSavedGearSets () player.gearSets = {}
local gearFile = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/gearsets.dat"
local is_file = io.open(gearFile)
if (is_file ~= nil) then table.load(gearFile, player.gearSets) end
end
function loadGearSetBackup () player.gearSets = {} table.load(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/gearsets.backup.dat", player.gearSets) end
-- functions below here are probably internal...
gear.isShiftingSwap = function(from, to)
for idxShiftItems, itemShiftList in pairs(common.shiftingItems) do local fromMatch, toMatch for shiftIdx, itemShift in pairs(itemShiftList) do fromMatch = fromMatch or rex.match(from, '^' .. itemShift .. '(.*)$') toMatch = toMatch or rex.match(to, '^' .. itemShift .. '(.*)$') end if (fromMatch and toMatch) then return true end end
return false
end
function equipGearSet (name, callback, partial, showDiffOnly)
if (not catalog or not catalog.itemsIndex or #catalog.itemsIndex == 0) then cecho('\n<green>TFECAT: <white>loading items from server... please hold\n\n') local cmd = matches[1] catalog.load(function() equipGearSet(name, callback, partial, showDiffOnly) end) return end
cecho('\n<green>Outfit: <white>equip gear set: ' .. name)
if (not showDiffOnly) then
-- if we haven't changed set within 30 seconds something must be horribly wrong local timeoutWatcher, timeoutTimer, pretimeoutTimer
timeoutWatcher = common.onNextEvent(common.events.CHANGED_EQUIPMENT, function() killTimer(timeoutTimer) if (pretimeoutTimer) then killTimer(pretimeoutTimer) end end)
pretimeoutTimer = tempTimer(20, function() if not table.contains({'standing', 'floating', 'swimming'}, gmcp.Char.Status.position) then send('|stand') end send('|eq') pretimeoutTimer = nil end, 'waiting on gear change (pretimeout)')
-- self destruct if gear hasn't changed within 30 seconds timeoutTimer = tempTimer(30, function() cecho('\n<red>Outfit: <white>failed to change into set within 30 seconds: ' .. name) timeoutWatcher() send('|gtell Timed out while attempting to change my gear - retrying') if not table.contains({'standing', 'floating', 'swimming'}, gmcp.Char.Status.position) then send('|stand') end player.equippingSet = nil equipGearSet(name, callback, partial, showDiffOnly) end, 'waiting for gear to change')
end
if (player.equippingSet) then
if (player.equippingSet == name) then
cecho('\n<yellow>Outfit: <white>already equipping set: ' .. name) common.onNextEvent(common.events.CHANGED_EQUIPMENT, function() if (callback) then callback() end end)
else
cecho('\n<red>Outfit: <white>waiting for prev gear change to complete before equiping ' .. name) common.onNextEvent(common.events.CHANGED_EQUIPMENT, function() equipGearSet(name, callback, partial, showDiffOnly) end)
if not table.contains({'standing', 'floating', 'swimming'}, gmcp.Char.Status.position) then send('|stand') end send('|eq')
end
return end
player.equippingSet = name
common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_EQUIPMENT, function()
-- echo('\ncurrent gear established...\n')
local newSet = player.gearSets[name]
if (newSet == nil) then
cecho('<red>Outfit Error: <white>set does not exist') if callback then callback() end
else
-- reset current swap list player.swapItems = {}
-- remove any items that have empty slots in new set if (not partial) then for slot, layers in pairs(player.gear) do
for layer, item in pairs(layers) do if (not (newSet[slot] and newSet[slot][layer])) then -- echo('\nneed to remove ' .. item.item) swapItems(item.item, '', slot, layer) end end
end end
-- swap any items different in the new set for slot, layers in pairs(newSet) do if (type(layers) == 'table') then -- in case junk like parsed gets in the data again for layer, item in pairs(layers) do -- add any items in a layer that doesn't exist in current set if (not (player.gear[slot] and player.gear[slot][layer])) then -- echo('\nneed to add new slot ' .. item.item) swapItems('', item.item, slot, layer) elseif (player.gear[slot][layer].item ~= item.item)then if gear.isShiftingSwap(player.gear[slot][layer].item, item.item) then cecho('\n<green>GEAR SWAP: <white>skipping shifting item swap: ' .. player.gear[slot][layer].item .. ' to ' .. item.item .. '\n') else -- cecho('\n\nneed to swapsises\n\n') -- display(player.gear[slot][layer].item, item.item, slot, layer) swapItems(player.gear[slot][layer].item, item.item, slot, layer) end end end else -- not sure how parsing is still in there (too lazy to investigate atm) if (slot ~= 'parsing') then cecho('\n<red>GEAR ERROR: <white>invalid data!!! slot: ' .. slot) end end end
-- check for 2h weapon, and remove everything in offhand if (newSet["right hand"] and newSet["right hand"].base) then local tcatItem = catalog.getSlotLayerItem("right hand" , "base", newSet["right hand"].base.item) if (not tcatItem) then cecho('\n<red>GEAR ERROR: <white>unable to find main hand weapon data: ' .. newSet["right hand"].base.item) else if catalog.hasAffect(tcatItem, 'Requires two hands.') then if (player.gear["left hand"]) then for layer, item in pairs(player.gear["left hand"]) do -- echo('\nneed to remove ' .. item.item) swapItems(item.item, '', "left hand", layer) end end end end end
-- check for offhand weapon and remove any other offhand things if (newSet["left hand"] and newSet["left hand"].base) then local lhw = catalog.getSlotLayerItem("left hand", "base", newSet["left hand"].base.item) if (not lhw) then cecho('\n<red>GEAR ERROR: <white>unable to find offhand weapon data: ' .. newSet["left hand"].base.item) else if lhw.itemType == 'weapon' and player.gear["left hand"] then for layer, item in pairs(player.gear["left hand"]) do -- echo('\nneed to remove ' .. item.item) if (layer ~= 'base') then swapItems(item.item, '', "left hand", layer) end end end end end
-- make sure we aren't just switching left/right things local removeRedundantSwap = function (slot, layer)
if (player.swapItems["left " .. slot] and player.swapItems["left " .. slot][layer] and player.swapItems["right " .. slot] and player.swapItems["right " .. slot][layer] and (player.swapItems["left " .. slot][layer].from == player.swapItems["right " .. slot][layer].to) and (player.swapItems["left " .. slot][layer].to == player.swapItems["right " .. slot][layer].from)) then -- remove redundant swap cecho('\n<green>GEAR SWAP: <white>removed redundant swap (left/right ' .. slot .. '.' .. layer .. ')') player.swapItems["left " .. slot][layer] = nil player.swapItems["right " .. slot][layer] = nil end
-- cloa.grea.prot.+3 -> cloa.prot.+3 -> cloa.invu.+3
end
removeRedundantSwap('hand finger', 'bottom') removeRedundantSwap('hand finger', 'under') removeRedundantSwap('hand finger', 'over') removeRedundantSwap('hand finger', 'base') removeRedundantSwap('hand finger', 'top') removeRedundantSwap('wrist', 'base') removeRedundantSwap('wrist', 'over')
-- ["left hand"] = { -- base = { -- from = "dar.ston.dagg.desp", -- to = "blac.stri.leat" -- } -- },
-- weapons are fucked up if we are dual weiling the same weap but want to swap left hand -- remove the right hand weap also in this case if ( player.swapItems["left hand"] and player.swapItems["left hand"].base) then
if ( player.gear["left hand"] and player.gear["left hand"].base and player.gear["right hand"] and player.gear["right hand"].base and player.gear["right hand"].base.item == player.gear["left hand"].base.item) then
-- if we are not swapping out the rhs weapon also, change it to 2.weapon
if not (player.swapItems["right hand"] and player.swapItems["right hand"].base) then player.swapItems["left hand"].base.from = '2.' .. player.swapItems["left hand"].base.from end
-- display('dual weilding, bleh!', player.swapItems["left hand"].base)
-- swapItems(player.gear["right hand"].base.item, player.gear["right hand"].base.item, "right hand", "base") end end
-- swap all layers on top of any layers changing due to fucked up things like Xanas bracelets for slot, layers in pairs(player.swapItems) do
-- for whatever reason sometimes the first item isnt the lowest layer local firstLayer = table.keys(layers)[1] local flIndex = table.index_of(common.layers,firstLayer)
for layer in pairs(layers) do local thisIndex = table.index_of(common.layers,layer) if (thisIndex < flIndex) then flIndex = thisIndex firstLayer = layer end end
if (firstLayer) then for idx = table.index_of(common.layers,firstLayer) + 1, #common.layers do local checkLayer = common.layers[idx] if ((not player.swapItems[slot] or not player.swapItems[slot][checkLayer]) and (player.gear[slot] and player.gear[slot][checkLayer])) then swapItems(player.gear[slot][checkLayer].item, player.gear[slot][checkLayer].item, slot, checkLayer) end end end
end
local cb = function () callback() end
if #table.keys(player.swapItems) == 0 then
cecho('\n<green>GEAR SWAP: <white>no gear needs swapping\n') player.equippingSet = nil
if cb then cb() end
raiseEvent(common.events.CHANGED_EQUIPMENT)
else
displaySwapItems()
if (showDiffOnly ~= true) then -- lets do it... performSwap(cb) else
player.equippingSet = nil if cb then cb() end end
end
end -- end check if this was a valid set
end)
send('|eq')
end
function displaySwapItems () -- display(player.swapItems) for k, slot in pairs(common.slots) do
if (player.swapItems[slot]) then
for k, layer in pairs(common.layers) do
if (player.swapItems[slot][layer]) then local swap = player.swapItems[slot][layer]
if swap.from ~= swap.to then -- display(slot,layer,swap.to) cecho('\n<green>GEAR SWAP: <white>' .. slot .. '.' .. layer .. ' - ' .. swap.from .. ' -> ' .. swap.to) end
end -- if layer exists in swap
end -- loop layers
end -- if
end -- loop slots
end
-- Error: invalid item switch of items in slot left hand -- { -- to = "fir.gian.scap", -- from = "cora.shie.reju" -- } -- { -- to = "cora.shie.reju", -- from = "cora.shie.reju" -- }
function swapItems (to, from, slot, layer)
-- wtf why are from and to back to front?
-- cecho('<green>swap: <white>swap to ' .. to .. ' from ' .. from .. '\n')
local flags = {}
if rex.find(to, [[(backpack|feather-patterned)]]) then -- cecho('\n\nBACKPACK ALEERT!\n\n') flags["removing backpack"] = true end
if (slot == nil) then cecho('<red>ERROR: <white>no slot provided on item swap ' .. to .. ' to ' .. from .. '\n') end
local swap = {from=common.itemShorten(to, true), to=common.itemShorten(from, true), flags = flags}
-- -- if isShiftingSwap(swap.to, swap.from) then -- cecho('\n<green>GEAR SWAP: <white>skipping shifting item swap: ' .. swap.to .. ' to ' .. swap.from .. '\n') -- return -- end
-- cloak of greater prot / cloak of invuln will revert to cloak of protection when removed local testProt,ench = rex.match(swap.to, [[^(cloa\.grea\.prot|cloa\.supe\.prot)(\.?\+?\d?)]]) if (testProt) then swap.to = 'cloa.prot' .. ench end
player.swapItems[slot] = player.swapItems[slot] or {}
if (player.swapItems[slot][layer]) then
if (player.swapItems[slot][layer].to == swap.from) then swap.from = player.swapItems[slot][layer].from elseif swap.from == player.swapItems[slot][layer].from and swap.to == player.swapItems[slot][layer].to then cecho('<red>GEAR SWAP: <white>duplicate swap requested ' .. to .. ' to ' .. from .. '\n') else cecho('Error: invalid item switch of items in slot ' .. slot .. '.' .. layer) end
end
player.swapItems[slot][layer] = swap
end
local shiftingGearFix = function(list)
-- shiftingGearFix({'red.ring', 'shif.blac.sabr','blue.ring'})
-- todo: update this for other shifting items. i.e the 2hander, or cloak of protection etc.
local addItems = {}
for idx, itemWorn in pairs(list) do
for idxShiftItems, itemShiftList in pairs(common.shiftingItems) do
for shiftIdx, itemShift in pairs(itemShiftList) do
-- will match if the item exists, and if the item is enchanted it local itemMatch = rex.match(itemWorn, '^' .. itemShift .. '(.*)$')
if itemMatch then -- display(itemWorn, itemShift, itemMatch) table.insert(addItems, {item = idxShiftItems, itemIdx = shiftIdx, enchant = itemMatch }) end
end
end
-- (rex.find(rhs.to,"shif.blac.shor") and rex.find(rhs.from ,"shif.blac.sabr")
end
for _, shiftData in pairs(addItems) do
for idx, item in pairs(common.shiftingItems[shiftData.item]) do
if idx ~= shiftData.itemIdx then table.insert(list, 1, item .. shiftData.enchant) end
end
end
return list
end
function swapCommands(removeList, wearList, noPackingList)
-- display('sc:', removeList, wearList, noPackingList)
-- dodgyness for shifting shortspear wearList = shiftingGearFix(wearList)
-- doing removelist also incase item has changed since we last looked at it -- looking at you cloak of protection/invulnerability etc removeList = shiftingGearFix(removeList)
if(#wearList > 0) then send('get ' .. table.concat(wearList, ',') .. ' from ' .. player.bag) end
if(#removeList > 0) then send('remove ' .. table.concat(removeList, ',')) end
if(#wearList > 0) then send('wear ' .. table.concat(wearList, ',')) end
if (noPackingList and #noPackingList) then for item in ipairs(noPackingList) do local idx = table.index_of(removeList, item) if (idx and idx > 0) then table.remove(removeList, idx) end end
end
if(#removeList > 0) then
if table.contains(removeList, 'cloa.supe.prot.+3') then local idx = table.index_of(removeList, 'cloa.supe.prot.+3') removeList[idx] = 'cloa.prot.+3' end
for idx, item in ipairs(removeList) do if item:match('2%.') then removeList[idx] = item:gsub('2%.','') end end send('put ' .. table.concat(removeList, ',') .. ' in ' .. player.bag) end
end
function performSwap(callback)
local co
co = coroutine.create(function()
njs50.onEmptyQueue(function() coroutine.resume(co) end) coroutine.yield()
local cb = callback
local removeList = {} local wearList = {} local noPackingList = {}
local removeLength = 0 local wearLength = 0
local idx
for k, slot in pairs(common.slots) do
if (player.swapItems[slot]) then
items = player.swapItems[slot]
for k, layer in pairs(common.layers) do -- for layer, swap in pairs(items) do local swap = items[layer]
if (items[layer]) then
if string.len(swap.from) > 0 then
if (swap.flags and table.contains(swap.flags, 'removing backpack')) then table.insert(noPackingList, swap.from) end
removeList = common.tfeItemListAdd(removeList, swap.from) -- this is an approximation since if it's already in the list -- we are only actually adding 2 (i.e 2*item) removeLength = removeLength + string.len(swap.from)
end
if string.len(swap.to) > 0 then
wearList = common.tfeItemListAdd(wearList, swap.to) -- this is an approximation since if it's already in the list -- we are only actually adding 2 (i.e 2*item) wearLength = wearLength + string.len(swap.to) end
end -- check if layer is being swapped
end -- end layer loop
if (wearLength > maxLength or removeLength > maxLength) then -- gotta remove items in the reverse order (i.e top layer first) swapCommands(common.reverseList(removeList), wearList) removeList = {} wearList = {} removeLength = 0 wearLength = 0
njs50.onEmptyQueue(function() coroutine.resume(co) end) coroutine.yield()
end
end -- end slot if end -- slot loop
-- display(wearList) -- display(removeList)
if (wearLength > 0 or removeLength > 0) then -- gotta remove items in the reverse order (i.e top layer first) swapCommands(common.reverseList(removeList), wearList, noPackingList) noPackingList = {}
njs50.onEmptyQueue(function() coroutine.resume(co) end) coroutine.yield()
end
common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_EQUIPMENT, function() cecho('\n<green>GEAR SWAP: <white>swap completed\n') player.equippingSet = nil
if cb then cb() end raiseEvent(common.events.CHANGED_EQUIPMENT) end) send('|group & |eq', false)
player.swapItems = {}
end) -- end of coroutine
coroutine.resume(co)
end
common.gearFind = function(set, callback)
local oBag = player.bag
local co
expandAlias('gs')
equipSet(set, function()
expandAlias('ps')
co = coroutine.create(function()
for idx, bag in ipairs(player.gearBags) do
send('with ' .. bag) player.bag = bag cecho('\nSEARCHING: ' .. player.bag .. '\n') equipSet(set, function() send('deposit ' .. bag) coroutine.resume(co) end) coroutine.yield()
end
player.bag = oBag if (callback) then njs50.onEmptyQueue(callback) end
end)
coroutine.resume(co)
end)
end

Script.name: check resources
Script.script:
common.updateStatus = function(callback) -- just wait for the next prompt... -- a gmcp update will have come by then -- common.onNextVitalsUpdate(callback)
-- fuck waiting. lets just go. gmcp should be updated all the time callback()
end
common.onNextVitalsUpdate = function(fn) return njs50.tempTimedNextEvent(7, 'gmcp.Char.Vitals', fn, fn) end
common.onOffsetReady = function(lessHp, lessMp, lessMoves, callback)
local readyStatus = common.checkResources(player.hp_max - lessHp, player.mp_max - lessMp, player.moves_max - lessMoves)
if(readyStatus) then callback() else common.checkFullTimer = common.onNextVitalsUpdate(function() common.checkFullTimer = nil common.onOffsetReady(lessHp, lessMp, lessMoves, callback) end) end
end
common.onManaReady = function(mana, callback)
local readyStatus = common.checkResources(0, mana, 0)
if(readyStatus) then callback() else
if (common.checkFullTimer) then cecho('\nalready waiting for mana or something\n') else common.checkFullTimer = common.onNextVitalsUpdate(function() common.checkFullTimer = nil common.onManaReady(mana, callback) end) end end
end
common.checkResources = function(hp, mp, moves)
hp = math.floor(math.min(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp, hp)) mp = math.floor(math.min(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxen, mp)) moves = math.floor(math.min(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmv, moves))
if (gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp >= hp and gmcp.Char.Vitals.en >= mp and gmcp.Char.Vitals.mv >= moves) then echo('\n\n .. READY TO KILL\n') return true else
local dHP = hp - gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp local dEN = mp - gmcp.Char.Vitals.en local dMV = moves - gmcp.Char.Vitals.mv
cecho('\n .. sleep more little tank: ') if (dHP > 0) then cecho('<red>' .. tostring(dHP) .. 'hp ') end if (dEN > 0) then cecho('<green>' .. tostring(dEN) .. 'e ') end if (dMV > 0) then cecho('<blue>' .. tostring(dMV) .. 'mv ') end cecho('\n') return false end
end
common.checkFull = function(options)
-- display('cf options', options)
options = options or {}
local hp = player.hp_max local mp = player.mp_max * 0.95 local mv = player.moves_max * 0.6
if (options.ignore_hp and options.ignore_hp == true) then hp = 1 end
if (options.max_moves and options.max_moves == true) then mv = player.moves_max end
return common.checkResources(hp, mp, mv) end
-- [ 75 Pal Ogr ] Darion 1510/1520 763/1038 306/321 16,597,229 -- [ 75 Pal Ogr ] Darion 1440/1576 708/728 291/296 16,597,229
common.onFullish = function (hp, mp, moves, callback)
local readyStatus = common.checkResources(hp, mp, moves)
if(readyStatus) then callback() else common.checkFullTimer = common.onNextVitalsUpdate(function() common.checkFullTimer = nil common.onFullish(hp, mp, moves, callback) end) end
end
common.onFull = function (callback, options)
-- display('getfull options:', options)
local readyStatus = common.checkFull(options)
if(readyStatus) then callback() else common.checkFullTimer = common.onNextVitalsUpdate(function() common.checkFullTimer = nil common.onFull(callback, options) end) end
end

Script.name: gear related
Script.script:
gear = gear or {} player = player or {}
local weaponAffects = { ["jeweled krynite spetum"] = { ["frost-covered"] = "push sapphire", }, ["jeweled krynite gladius"] = { ["frost-covered"] = "twist sapphire", }, ["jeweled krynite javelin"] = { ["frost-covered"] = "push sapphire", }, ["jeweled krynite greataxe"] = { ["flaming"] = "twist ruby", } }
local getWeaponAffects = function(weapon, cb)
local baseName = rex.gsub(weapon, [[\s\+\d]], '')
local weapTrig = timedTempTrigger(10, 1, [[^You look at (.*) you are (holding|wielding)\.$]], function()
if (matches[3] == 'wielding') then
-- missing the cleric holy weapon thing local affects = gear.getWeaponAffects(matches[2])
local wa = weaponAffects[baseName]
if (wa) then for aff, cmd in pairs(wa) do if not (affects[aff]) then send(cmd) end end end
cb(affects)
else
cb()
end
end)
send('look ' .. common.dotCase(weapon))
end
player.getWeaponAffects = function(cb)
local rhs, lhs
local rhWeap = player.gear["right hand"].base.item
getWeaponAffects(rhWeap, function(affects)
rhs = {weapon = rhWeap, affects = affects}
if (player.skills["off-hand attack"] and player.skills["off-hand attack"] > 0 and player.gear["left hand"] and player.gear["left hand"].base) then
local lhWeap = player.gear["left hand"].base.item
-- need to wait til the current line is done processing -- otherwise we'll trigger twice on the first weap tempTimer(0, function() getWeaponAffects(lhWeap, function(affects) lhs = {weapon = lhWeap, affects = affects}
cb(rhs,lhs) end) end) else cb(rhs) end
end)
end
gear.gatherGroupRepairWeapons = function(groupWeapons, cb)
if group.repairWeapons and #table.keys(group.repairWeapons) > 0 then cecho('\n\n<red>REPAIR:<white> repairing group weapons is already in progress\n\n') send('gtell attempted to repair group weapons while a repair was already in progress - gear.returnGroupRepairWeapons() to return') return end
group.repairWeapons = {}
for member, weapons in pairs(groupWeapons) do
-- if either weapoin needs repair if weapons[2].condition < 8 or weapons[1].condition < 8 then
group.repairWeapons[member] = group.repairWeapons[member] or {}
if (weapons[1].condition < 8) then -- main hand repair table.insert(group.repairWeapons[member], '' .. common.itemShorten(weapons[1].weapon, true)) end -- offhand
if (weapons[2].condition < 8) then -- offhand repair local item = common.itemShorten(weapons[2].weapon, true) if weapons[2].weapon == weapons[1].weapon then table.insert(group.repairWeapons[member], 1, '2.' .. item) -- send main hand anyway because i'm too lazy to figuere out if (weapons[1].condition >= 8) then table.insert(group.repairWeapons[member], '' .. common.itemShorten(weapons[1].weapon, true)) end else table.insert(group.repairWeapons[member], item) end end -- offhand
end -- if either weapon needs repair
end
-- if we have nothing to do then reset everything if (#table.keys(group.repairWeapons) == 0) then group.repairWeapons = nil if (cb) then cb() end return end
local co
local resume = function() local ok, errorMsg = coroutine.resume(co) if not ok then error("Error in co-routine gather group weapons doe repair: " .. errorMsg) end end
co = coroutine.create(function() local groupWeapons = {}
send('gl')
for member, weapons in pairs(group.repairWeapons) do
local cmd = 'remove ' .. table.concat(weapons, ',') .. ' & give ' .. table.concat(weapons, ',') .. ' ' .. gmcp.Char.Score.name
murder.doAck(member, cmd, function()
send('put ' .. table.concat(weapons, ',') .. ' loot')
resume() end, resume, 15000) coroutine.yield() end
send('pl') cb() end) -- end of coroutine
resume()
end
gear.returnGroupRepairWeapons = function(cb)
-- if we have nothing to do then reset everything if (not group.repairWeapons or #table.keys(group.repairWeapons) == 0) then group.repairWeapons = nil if (cb) then cb() end return end
local co
local resume = function() local ok, errorMsg = coroutine.resume(co) if not ok then error("Error in co-routine gather group weapons doe repair: " .. errorMsg) end end
co = coroutine.create(function() local groupWeapons = {}
send('gl')
for member, weapons in pairs(group.repairWeapons) do
send('get ' .. table.concat(weapons, ',') .. ' loot') send('give ' .. table.concat(weapons, ',') .. ' ' .. member)
local cmd = 'wear ' .. table.concat(weapons, ',')
murder.doAck(member, cmd, resume, resume, 15000) coroutine.yield() end
send('pl')
group.repairWeapons = nil
if (cb) then cb() end end) -- end of coroutine
resume()
end
gear.repairGroupRepairWeapons = function()
-- if we have nothing to do then reset everything if (not group.repairWeapons or #table.keys(group.repairWeapons) == 0) then return end
-- local repaired =
send('gl')
for member, weapons in pairs(group.repairWeapons) do
send('get ' .. table.concat(weapons, ',') .. ' loot')
for idx, weap in ipairs(weapons) do send('dip ' .. weap .. ' youth') send('repair ' .. weap) send('put ' .. weap .. ' loot') end
end
send('pl')
end
gear.lowestGroupWeapon = function(groupWeapons)
local condition = 10
for member, weapons in pairs(groupWeapons) do for idx, weapon in pairs(weapons) do if weapon.condition < condition then condition = weapon.condition end end end
return condition
end
gear.getWeaponAffects = function(weapon)
-- missing the cleric holy weapon thing local affects = { ['acid-dripping'] = weapon:find('acid-dripping') ~= nil, ['spiteful'] = weapon:find('spiteful') ~= nil, ['jinxing'] = weapon:find('jinxing') ~= nil, ['flaming'] = weapon:find('flaming') ~= nil, ['divinely flamed'] = weapon:find('divinely flamed') ~= nil, ['frost-covered'] = weapon:find('frost-covered') ~= nil, ['thanatotic'] = weapon:find('thanatotic') ~= nil, }
return affects
end
gear.getGroupWeapons = function(cb)
local co
local resume = function() local ok, errorMsg = coroutine.resume(co) if not ok then error("Error in co-routine get group weapons: " .. errorMsg) end end
co = coroutine.create(function() local groupWeapons = {} for member in pairs(gmcp.Group.members) do gear.checkMemberWeapons(member, function(weapons) groupWeapons[member] = weapons resume() end) coroutine.yield() end group.weapons = groupWeapons if (cb) then cb(groupWeapons) end end) -- end of coroutine
resume()
end
gear.checkMemberWeapons = function(member, cb)
local t1, t2, t3
local killTriggers = function() killTrigger(t1) killTrigger(t2) killTrigger(t3) end
local weapons = {}
local weapon, condition
t1 = tempRegexTrigger([[^You look at (.*) (]] .. member .. [[|you) (is|are) wielding\.$]], function() weapon = matches[2] end)
t2 = tempRegexTrigger([[^\s+Condition: (.*)$]], function() condition = common.conditions[matches[2]]
table.insert(weapons, {weapon = weapon, condition = condition})
if (#weapons > 1) then killTriggers() tempTimer(0, function() cb(weapons) end, 'prevent double execution on this line') end
end)
t3 = tempRegexTrigger([[^Nothing matching '(\d).weapon' found on ]] .. member .. [[\.$]], function()
weapon = 'none' condition = common.conditions['perfect']
table.insert(weapons, {weapon = weapon, condition = condition})
if (#weapons > 1) then killTriggers() cb(weapons) end
end)
send('look ' .. member .. ' 1.weapon & look ' .. member .. ' 2.weapon')
end
gear.repair = function(cb, repairLevel)
repairLevel = repairLevel or 'excellent'
-- need to blacklist by zone
local blacklist = { ["entropic orb"] = true, ["golden ball of light"] = true, ["delicate silver charm bracelet"] = true, -- ["gem-studded leather quiver"] = true, -- can't fix in kha-da -- [""] = true, }
send('gs') send('get youth.potion ' .. player.bag) send('ps')
if (group.repairWeapons and #table.keys(group.repairWeapons) > 0) then gear.repairGroupRepairWeapons() end
common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_EQUIPMENT, function()
for k, slot in pairs(common.slots) do
if (player.gear[slot]) then
local repairList = {} local removeList = {}
for k, layer in pairs(common.layers) do
if (player.gear[slot][layer]) then
local item = player.gear[slot][layer] local shortItem = common.itemShorten(item.item, true)
if (common.conditions[item.condition] < common.conditions[repairLevel] and not blacklist[item.item]) then table.insert(repairList, shortItem)
if rex.match(slot, [[^left]]) then display('left hand item!') local rslot = rex.gsub(slot, [[^left]], 'right') if player.gear[rslot] and player.gear[rslot][layer] then if common.itemShorten(player.gear[rslot][layer].item) == shortItem then shortItem = '2.' .. shortItem end end end
end
if (#repairList > 0) then table.insert(removeList, shortItem) end
end
end
-- we have something to repair if (#repairList > 0) then -- display(repairList) -- display(removeList)
send('|remove ' .. table.concat(common.reverseList(removeList), ','))
local shiftList = { ["cloa.supe.prot.+3"] = 'cloa.prot.+3', ["cloa.grea.prot.+3"] = 'cloa.prot.+3', }
-- this item changes after being removed. bleh. -- if more items do this we prob will need a better way to do this.
for initItem, removedItem in pairs(shiftList) do
if table.contains(removeList, initItem) then local idx = table.index_of(removeList, initItem) removeList[idx] = removedItem end
if table.contains(repairList, initItem) then local idx = table.index_of(repairList, initItem) repairList[idx] = removedItem end end
for idx = 1, #repairList do send('|dip ' .. repairList[idx] .. ' youth.potion') send('|repair ' .. repairList[idx]) end
for idx = 1, #removeList do removeList[idx] = rex.gsub(removeList[idx], '2.', '') end
send('|wear ' .. table.concat(removeList, ','))
end
end
end -- end slot loop
send('gs') send('put youth.potion ' .. player.bag) send('ps')
if (cb) then njs50.onEmptyQueue(cb) end
end) tempTimer(3, function() njs50.onEmptyQueue( function() send('|eq') end) end, 'pre repair delay')
end
gear.progressPlan = function(sets)
-- display(sets)
local pp = {}
for idx, set in ipairs(sets) do
local gs = player.gearSets[set]
if (gs) then
for slot, layers in pairs(gs) do
if (type(layers) == "table") then for layer, item in pairs(layers) do
-- display(slot, layer, item.item)
pp[slot] = pp[slot] or {} pp[slot][layer] = pp[slot][layer] or {}
if (#pp[slot][layer] == 0 or pp[slot][layer][#pp[slot][layer]] ~= item.item) then table.insert(pp[slot][layer], item.item) end
end end
end
end
end
-- display(pp)
cecho('\n|Body Location|Layer|Item|\n') cecho('|:-|:-|:-|\n')
local lastSlot = ''
for is, slot in ipairs(catalog.common.slots) do
for il, layer in ipairs(catalog.common.layers) do
if (pp[slot] and pp[slot][layer]) then
local items = pp[slot][layer]
for idx, item in ipairs(items) do
local tcatItem = catalog.getSlotLayerItem(slot, layer, item)
if (tcatItem) then pp[slot][layer][idx] = item .. ' (lvl '.. tostring(tcatItem.Level) .. ')' end
end
cecho('|') if (lastSlot ~= slot) then cecho(slot) lastSlot = slot else cecho(' ') end cecho('|' .. layer .. '|') cecho(table.concat(pp[slot][layer], ' > ') .. '|\n')
end
end
end
end
