Script.name: murder
Script.script:
------------------------------------------------- -- Put your Lua functions here. -- -- -- -- Note that you can also use external Scripts -- -------------------------------------------------
murder = murder or {}
murder.defaults = { enabled=false, speedwalking = false, paused = false, noBacktracking = nil, waitForSplit = true, exits={}, targets = {}, ignoreTargets = {}, nonHostileTargets = {}, nastyTargets = {}, waypoints = {}, currentWaypoint = 0, events = { PATH_COMPLETE = 'MURDER:path_completed', PENDING_MOVE_COMPLETE = 'MURDER:pending_move_completed', }, move_pending = nil, idleCheckTimer = nil, roomChangeHandler = nil, killWatcher = nil, stepAction = nil, notifyMobBeforeMove = false,
waitForSplitAmount = nil,
ignoreAwol = {}
}
murder.init = function () if (murder.enabled ~= true) then cecho('\n\n<red>MUDER: <white>initialised\n\n') for k,v in pairs(murder.defaults) do murder[k] = v end else common.log('\n\n<red>MUDER: <white>skipped init due to being enabled\n\n') end end
murder.init()
player.gettingFull = false murder.castingLocked = nil
murder.setLocalNextRoom = function(exit)
-- only hit things in the current room and only if there is only one thing -- also can't be a pending hit already if (exit and exit.firstTarget) then
local ccMobs = ''
if (exit.targetCount >= 1) then for idx = #exit.allTargets, 1, -1 do ccMobs = ccMobs .. exit.allTargets[idx] if (idx ~= 1) then ccMobs = ccMobs .. ',' end end end
player.nextRoom = { targetCount = exit.targetCount, aoe = exit.nonTargetCount == 0, nasty = exit.nastyTarget, target = exit.firstTarget, ccMobs = ccMobs, }
end
end
murder.autoScan = function ()
if (murder.autoScanWatcher) then killAnonymousEventHandler(murder.autoScanWatcher) murder.autoScanWatcher = nil end
murder.autoScanWatcher = registerAnonymousEventHandler(tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED, function () murder.sawAction = false end)
end
murder.autoScan()
murder.wait_message = 'waiting for split'
murder.onRoomClear = function (cb)
local onclear
onclear = common.onNextEvent(common.events.ROOM_CLEAR, function() onclear = nil cb() end)
-- clean up in case we moved before room was clear common.onNextEvent(tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED, function() if (onclear) then onclear() onclear = nil end end)
end
murder.idleScanner = function ()
if (murder.idleScannerResetLockout == nil) then
tempTimer(2, function() murder.idleScannerResetLockout = nil end, 'murder idle timer reset lockout')
murder.idleScannerResetLockout = true murder.clearIdleScanTimer()
if (murder.enabled) then common.log('\n<green>MURDER: <white>started idle scan timer!\n') murder.idleTimer = tempTimer(10, function ()
-- cancel failed power scans if needed if (murder.powerScanning) then common.log('\n<orange>MURDER: <white>idle during power scan, clearing queue then canceling power scan\n') njs50.onEmptyQueue(function() if (murder.powerScanWatcher) then murder.powerScanWatcher() end murder.powerScanning = nil end) murder.idleScanner() else common.log('\n<orange>MURDER: <white>scannign due to idle for 10s!\n') murder.scan('idle scanner') murder.idleScanner() end
end, 'murder idle timer') end
end
end
murder.clearIdleScanTimer = function() if (murder.idleTimer) then common.log('\n<green>MURDER: <white>cleared existing idle scan timer!\n') killTimer(murder.idleTimer) murder.idleTimer = nil end end
murder.extendIdleScanner = function() if (murder.idleTimer ~= nil) then murder.idleScanner() end end
local defaultKillCommand = function(exit)
if (exit and exit.firstTarget) then
if (player.getAttackCommand) then return player.getAttackCommand(exit.firstTarget) end
return 'kill ' .. exit.firstTarget
else return '' end
end
murder.smiteCommand = function(exit)
if (exit and exit.firstTarget) then
if (player.getSmiteCommmand) then return player.getSmiteCommmand(exit.firstTarget) elseif (player.getAttackCommand) then return player.getAttackCommand(exit.firstTarget) else return 'kil ' .. exit.firstTarget end
else return '' end
end
murder.defaultKillCommand = murder.defaultKillCommand or defaultKillCommand
murder.sleepKillCommand = function(exit)
local sleepCmd = ''
if (exit) then
-- display(exit)
-- setup next target so we can skip auto cast on combat if (exit.firstTarget) then player.sleepTarget = exit.firstTarget:lower() common.log('\n\n<yellow>MUDER: <white>set sleep target from sleep kill command (' .. player.sleepTarget .. ')\n\n') end
-- only consider mists if everything is a target and more than 2 mobs if (exit.nonTargetCount == 0 and exit.targetCount > 1) then
sleepCmd = 'cast mists' if (murder.preSleeping) then sleepCmd = sleepCmd .. ' & queue scan' end return sleepCmd end
for k,v in pairs(exit.allTargets) do sleepCmd = sleepCmd .. 'cast sleep ' .. v .. ' & ' end
-- add a scan to trigger next move when we arnen't killing things if (murder.preSleeping) then sleepCmd = sleepCmd .. 'queue scan & ' end
return sleepCmd .. ' level' -- ' cast sleep'
else return '' end
end
murder.execute = function(step, callback)
common.log('\n\n<red>MURDER: <white>executing step!!\n\n')
-- clear any pending moves if they exist already murder.clearPendingMove()
murder.resetState()
-- farmer.options
-- set the names of targets to murder -- combine step targets with targets from options murder.setTargets( step.targets or farmer.options.targets or {}, step.nonHostileTargets or farmer.options.nonHostileTargets or {}, step.ignoreTargets or farmer.options.ignoreTargets or {}, step.nastyTargets or farmer.options.nastyTargets or {} )
murder.setWaypoints(step.waypoints)
murder.stepAction = step.stepAction or farmer.options.stepAction
murder.notifyMobBeforeMove = farmer.options.notifyMobBeforeMove
-- prevent true overriding false if (step.notifyMobBeforeMove ~= nil) then murder.notifyMobBeforeMove = step.notifyMobBeforeMove end
murder.callback = callback
murder.getKillCommand = step.getKillCommand or farmer.options.getKillCommand or murder.defaultKillCommand
murder.waitForSplitAmount = step.waitForSplitAmount or farmer.options.waitForSplitAmount
murder.stepOptions = step.options or {}
common.log('\n\n<green>MURDER: <white>muder step started\n\n') murder.registerHandlers()
murder.exploring = false tfe.move_queued = false
murder.enabled = true murder.paused = false murder.holdHere = false murder.step_action_pending = nil
murder.noBacktracking = step.noBacktracking or farmer.options.noBacktracking
murder.waitForSplit = step.waitForSplit if (murder.waitForSplit == nil) then murder.waitForSplit = farmer.options.waitForSplit end if (murder.waitForSplit == nil) then murder.waitForSplit = true end
murder.stepOptions = murder.stepOptions or {}
if (murder.stepOptions.preSleeping) then murder.preSleeping = true send('gstat going to pre sleep these suckers yo!') else murder.preSleeping = false end
murder.resetIdleTimer() murder.idleScanner()
common.log('\n<blue>MURDER: next invoked (from murder.execute)!\n') tempTimer(0, function() murder.scan('murder.execute') end)
end
murder.setWaypoints = function (waypoints) common.log('\n<green>MURDER: <white>setting waypoints (' .. table.concat(waypoints, ', ') .. ')\n')
tfe.configureWalkPath(waypoints) murder.clearPendingMove()
end
murder.clearPendingMove = function () if (murder.move_pending) then common.log('\n<green>MURDER: <white>Pending move cleared!') murder.move_pending() murder.move_pending = nil raiseEvent(murder.events.PENDING_MOVE_COMPLETE) end end
murder.killHandlers = function ()
if (murder.roomChangeHandler) then killAnonymousEventHandler(murder.roomChangeHandler) murder.roomChangeHandler = nil end
if (murder.combatEventWatcher) then killAnonymousEventHandler(murder.combatEventWatcher) murder.combatEventWatcher = nil end
-- how is this different to roomChangeHandler??? if (murder.roomChangeWatcher) then killAnonymousEventHandler(murder.roomChangeWatcher) murder.roomChangeWatcher = nil end
end
murder.registerHandlers = function()
murder.killHandlers()
murder.roomChangeHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler(common.events.SCAN_PROCESSED, function () common.log('\n<blue>MURDER: <white>next was invoked (by scan)!\n') murder.resetIdleTimer() murder.nextStep() end)
-- reset idle timer if there is fighting murder.combatEventWatcher = registerAnonymousEventHandler(common.events.COMBAT_ATTACK, murder.extendIdleScanner)
-- reset idle timer on room change murder.roomChangeWatcher = registerAnonymousEventHandler(tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED, murder.extendIdleScanner)
end
function murder.hold(msg) msg = msg or '' common.log('\n\n<red>MURDER: <white>muder holding here - ' .. tostring(msg) .. '\n\n') murder.holdHere = true murder.clearShortSpeedWalkTimer() end
function murder.unhold(msg) msg = msg or '' common.log('\n\n<red>MURDER: <white>muder cancelling hold - ' .. tostring(msg) .. '\n\n') murder.holdHere = false murder.startShortSpeedWalkTimer() murder.scan('stopping hold') end
function murder.stop () cecho('\n\n<red>MURDER: <white>muder path stopped\n\n')
murder.enabled = false
murder.noBacktracking = nil
murder.noRegroup = false murder.preSleeping = false murder.exploring = false
murder.setTargets({},{},{}, {}) murder.callback = nil
murder.powerScanning = nil
murder.cancelIdleTimer() murder.clearPendingMove()
murder.killHandlers ()
murder.clearIdleScanTimer()
end
function murder.explore() murder.fixCommas = {} murder.mobElements = {} murder.xpoints = {} murder.stop() murder.exploring = true murder.notifyMobBeforeMove = true murder.getKillCommand = murder.defaultKillCommand end
function murder.resetIdleTimer ()
murder.cancelIdleTimer()
murder.idleCheckTimer = tempTimer(60, function() cecho('\n\n\n<red>WARNING:: <white>IDLE FOR 60 seconds!!!\n\n\n') murder.resetState() murder.clearPendingMove() combat.reset() common.log('\n<blue>MURDER: <white>scanning to invoke next step (idle timer)!\n') murder.scan('long idle timer') murder.incrementLapInfo('long idle timeout') end, 'murder idle check timer')
end
function murder.cancelIdleTimer () if (murder.idleCheckTimer) then killTimer(murder.idleCheckTimer) murder.idleCheckTimer = nil end end
function murder.advanceWaypoint ()
murder.advancePending = nil
common.log('\n\n<green>MURDER: <yellow>advance waypoint invoked...\n\n')
-- kill any outstanding timers: murder.clearShortSpeedWalkTimer() murder.cancelIdleTimer()
-- display(murder.waypoints, murder.currentWaypointIdx) common.log('\n\n<green>MURDER: <yellow>MURDER PATH COMPLETE\n\n')
murder.hold()
if (murder.callback) then murder.callback() end
end
function murder.updatePath ()
common.log('\n<blue>MURDER:<white> updating current steps murder route\n')
if (not tfe.rerouteSpeedwalk()) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>unable to update path.\n') expandAlias('farm stop') end
end
murder.cmdTypes = { MOVE = 'movement', ATTACK = 'attack', WAIT_SPLIT = 'wait for split' }
local shortSpeedWalkTimerId local combatRestartSpeedWalkTimer local pendingExitOpen
function murder.startShortSpeedWalkTimer ()
if murder.holdHere then common.log('<red> <- attempted restart short speed walk timer while holding') return end
-- clear any existing timer murder.clearShortSpeedWalkTimer()
if (murder.enabled) then -- give us 5 seconds to move... shortSpeedWalkTimerId = tempTimer(7, function () cecho('\n<yellow:blue>MURDER: <white:black>7 seconds without move!!! - updating path...\n') player.pendingAttack = nil murder.updatePath() murder.clearPendingMove() murder.scan('short speedwalk timer') end, 'short speed walk timer') end
combatRestartSpeedWalkTimer = common.onNextEvent(common.events.COMBAT_ATTACK, function() cecho('<green> <- restart speed walk timeout ') combatRestartSpeedWalkTimer = nil player.pendingAttack = nil murder.startShortSpeedWalkTimer() end)
end
function murder.clearShortSpeedWalkTimer ()
if (shortSpeedWalkTimerId ~= nil) then killTimer(shortSpeedWalkTimerId) shortSpeedWalkTimerId = nil end
if (pendingExitOpen ~= nil) then pendingExitOpen() pendingExitOpen = nil end
if (combatRestartSpeedWalkTimer ~= nil) then combatRestartSpeedWalkTimer() combatRestartSpeedWalkTimer = nil end
end
function murder.move (cmd, reverse, delayCommand)
-- send move command
if murder.holdHere then
cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>attempted to move while holding here (wtf?)\n')
elseif (not murder.move_pending) then
murder.startShortSpeedWalkTimer()
murder.move_pending = common.onNextEvent(tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED, function (evt) -- cecho('<yellow> <- room changed, awaiting on scan ') common.log('<yellow> <- room changed, clearing timers/pending moves etc') tfe.advanceStepPosition(reverse) murder.clearShortSpeedWalkTimer() murder.clearPendingMove() end)
if (delayCommand and delayCommand > 0) then
tempTimer(delayCommand, function() murder.startShortSpeedWalkTimer() -- resest timer after delay expandAlias(cmd) end)
else expandAlias(cmd) end
else -- else murder.move_pending already exists
common.log('\n<red>MURDER: <white>attempted to move while move was already pending (wtf?)\n')
end
end
function murder.reroute () common.log('\n<blue>MURDER: <white>next invoked (reroute)!\n') murder.updatePath() murder.clearPendingMove() murder.scan('reroute of murder path') common.log('<green><-- scan from reroute\n') end
function murder.resume (skipScan) murder.paused = false send('gstat murdering will resume')
if (skipScan ~= true) then murder.scan('murder resume') end
end
function murder.pause () murder.paused = true send('gstat murdering will be suspendend after current tasks') end
function murder.nextStep(actionPerformed)
if (murder.silenced) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>waiting for silenced party member to be fixed\n') return end
if (murder.powerScanning) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>waiting for power scan to complete\n') return end
if (murder.shortRegroup) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>waiting for short regroup scan to complete\n') return end
if (pendingExitOpen) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>waiting for an exit to open\n') return end
if (murder.sleepDancing) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>waiting for the sleep dance to finish\n') return end
if (murder.advancePending) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>waiting murder to advance (pending step action)\n') return end
if (farmer.advancePending) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>waiting farmer to advance (pending action)\n') return end
if (murder.exitForSleepKill == true) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>waiting for slept mob to die before resuming actions\n') return end
if (murder.move_pending ~= nil) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>attempted to perform next step while move was already pending (wtf?)\n') return end
if (murder.step_action_pending ~= nil) then cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>attempted to perform next step while step action was pending (wtf?)\n') return end
if (player.pendingAttack) then cecho('\n<green>MURDER: <white>next step invoked but an attack is currently pending (clearing for next scan)\n') player.pendingAttack = nil return end
-- if there is a step action perform it before we do anything else if (murder.stepAction and not actionPerformed) then
common.log('\n -=[ performing step action ]=-\n')
if (murder.stepAction and type(murder.stepAction) == 'string') then
send(murder.stepAction) murder.nextStep(true)
elseif (murder.stepAction and type(murder.stepAction) == 'function') then murder.cancelIdleTimer() murder.clearShortSpeedWalkTimer() murder.step_action_pending = true
murder.stepAction(function() murder.sawAction = false murder.step_action_pending = nil murder.resetIdleTimer() murder.nextStep(true) end)
else cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>unknown type of step action: ' .. type(murder.stepAction)) end
return end
local exitHasTargets = function (dir)
local thisExit = murder.exits[dir]
if (thisExit and (thisExit.targetCount > 0 or thisExit.nonHostileTargetCount > 0)) then return true end
return false
end
murder.resetIdleTimer()
if (murder.enabled and not murder.paused and not murder.holdHere) then
common.log('\n\n -=[ murderer wants to act ]=-\n\n')
-- if there is something we need to kill in the current roomLocked if (not murder.preSleeping and exitHasTargets('here')) then -- there is something in this room to sort out... do it local cmd, attackPending = murder.getKillCommand(murder.exits.here, murder.exits, 'here')
if ((cmd and cmd ~= '') or attackPending) then cecho('\n<orange>MURDER: <white>kill mob in the current room') expandAlias(cmd) return end
end
-- pause to get moves if someone is low on moves if (group.lowest_moves <= 10) then send('gstat someone be low on moves, waiting for 10...') murder.paused = true -- cecho('\n<yellow>MUDER: <white>need to get moves\n')
tempTimer(10, function() murder.paused = false murder.scan('waiting on moves') end) return -- low on moves. no moves to be done this time... end -- not low on moves
-- check the previous room to see if something has moved into it... -- it's nice to keep our escape clear... -- don't do it if we're in the middle of sleep killing something tho local dirback = tfe.getNextDirection(true)
if (not murder.preSleeping and not murder.noBacktracking and dirback and dirback ~= '' and exitHasTargets(dirback) and murder.exitForSleepKill ~= true and not murder.exits[dirback].unknown) then
cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>mob(s) in previous room ' .. dirback)
local exit = murder.exits[dirback] local cmd = tfe.getNextStep(true) .. ' & ' .. murder.getKillCommand(exit, murder.exits, dirback) player.pendingAttack = true
if (murder.notifyMobBeforeMove ) then if (not murder.notifyBeforeMoveLockout) then murder.notifyBeforeMoveLockout = true murder.sendNextTarget(exit)
tempTimer(1.5, function () murder.notifyBeforeMoveLockout = nil end) murder.move(cmd, true, 1.5)
else cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>move already in the queue (delay pending notify)\n\n') end
else send('gstat going back to get '.. exit.firstTarget) murder.move(cmd, true) send('|unhide') end
return
end
local dir = tfe.getNextStep()
-- if we're at the end of this waypoint then advance... (perform step action first if it exists) if (dir == nil or dir == '') then
cecho('\n<orange>MURDER: <white>No move commands left for this step!\n') murder.advancePending = true murder.advanceWaypoint() return
end
local moveDirection = tfe.getNextDirection()
-- /****** WE ARE MOVING (forwards) IF WE GOT HERE ********/ --
local exit = murder.exits[moveDirection]
-- if the next exit isn't open abandon this and open it before trying again (need a new scan) if tfe.isExitClosed(moveDirection) then
cecho('\n<orange>MURDER: <white>waiting for ' .. moveDirection .. ' to open') -- display(njs50.gmcp.previous.exitInfo)
tfe.openExit(moveDirection, function() murder.scan('exit opened') end)
return
end
-- if we are speedwalking... (or nothing in the next room) if (not exit) then
local cmd = dir
murder.move(cmd) return
end
-- setup something to scan if we are idle for too long murder.idleScanner()
-- if the next room is unknown lets power scan it if exit.unknown then
common.log('\n<green>Murder: <white>need to power scan the next room\n')
local targetRoom = gmcp.Room.Info.exits[moveDirection]
local targetRoomExits = getRoomExits(targetRoom)
local reverseMoveDir = tfe.consts.reverse_dirs[moveDirection]
if ( targetRoomExits[reverseMoveDir] == gmcp.Room.Info.num ) then
murder.powerScanning = true
murder.powerScanTimer = tempTimer(20, function() cecho('\n<red>Murder: <white>power scan did not complete within 20s\n') if (murder.powerScanWatcher) then murder.powerScanWatcher() end murder.powerScanning = nil murder.powerScanTimer = nil murder.scan('power scan fucked out') end)
murder.powerScanWatcher = common.onNextEvent(tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED, function() -- send('gstat moved one room') murder.powerScanWatcher = common.onNextEvent(tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED, function() -- send('gstat moved two rooms') murder.powerScanning = nil murder.powerScanWatcher = nil killTimer(murder.powerScanTimer) murder.powerScanTimer = nil end) end)
send('gstat power scanning unknown territory [' .. tostring(targetRoom) .. ']') send(moveDirection .. ' & ' .. reverseMoveDir)
else
send('gstat unable to powerscan due to reverse path not existing in map')
end
--
return end
-- check if we need to wait for mobs to split if (murder.waitForSplit == true and murder.waitForSplitAmount and exit.targetCount >= murder.waitForSplitAmount) then
common.log('\n<green>Murder: <white>waiting on split\n')
if (not murder.splitWaitStart) then send('gstat waiting on split, next could be anything!') murder.splitWaitStart = murder.splitWaitStart or getEpoch()
local msg = 'Last mob was killed ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(lk) .. ' ago' common.onFirstEvent({common.events.COMBAT_STARTED, tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED}, function() local duration = getEpoch() - murder.splitWaitStart farmer.lapInfo['split wait'] = farmer.lapInfo['split wait'] or 0 farmer.lapInfo['split wait'] = farmer.lapInfo['split wait'] + math.ceil(duration) murder.splitWaitStart = nil send('gstat waiting time for split was: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(duration)) end)
end
murder.paused = true
if (murder.notifyMobBeforeMove) then if (exit.distinctTargets > 1) then -- send('gstat next could be either of those things') else murder.sendNextTarget(exit) end end
tempTimer(1.5, function() murder.paused = false if (murder.splitWaitStart) then local duration = getEpoch() - murder.splitWaitStart murder.scan('waiting on split, current wait time: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(duration)) else murder.scan('was paused for split, but prob had walkin') end end)
common.log(murder.wait_message)
return
else
local killCmd = murder.getKillCommand(exit, murder.exits, moveDirection)
local cmd = dir .. ' & ' .. killCmd
murder.paused = false if (murder.notifyMobBeforeMove ) then
if (not murder.notifyBeforeMoveLockout) then murder.notifyBeforeMoveLockout = true murder.sendNextTarget(exit) tempTimer(1.5, function () murder.notifyBeforeMoveLockout = nil end) murder.move(cmd, false, 1.5) if (killCmd ~= '') then player.pendingAttack = true end else cecho('\n<red>MURDER: <white>move already in the queue (delay pending notify)\n\n') end
else murder.move(cmd) if (killCmd ~= '') then player.pendingAttack = true end end
end
else
if (murder.holdHere) then cecho('\n\n -=[ murderer holding here ]=-\n\n') elseif(murder.paused) then cecho('\n\n -=[ murderer paused ]=-\n\n') else cecho('\n\n -=[ murderer disabled ]=-\n\n') end
end -- end if murder is enabled
end
murder.sendNextTarget = function(exit)
local cmd = 'gstat next room has '
local count = exit.targetCount + exit.nonHostileTargetCount
if count <= 1 then cmd = cmd .. tostring(count) .. ' target, ' else cmd = cmd .. tostring(count) .. ' targets, ' end
if(exit.nonTargetCount == 0) then cmd = cmd .. 'aoe-safe,' else cmd = cmd .. 'no-aoe,' end
if (exit.nastyTarget) then cmd = cmd .. ' destroy: ' .. exit.firstTarget else cmd = cmd .. ' attack: ' .. exit.firstTarget end
if (count >= 1) then cmd = cmd .. ', cc-order: ' for idx = #exit.allTargets, 1, -1 do cmd = cmd .. exit.allTargets[idx] if (idx ~= 1) then cmd = cmd .. ',' end end end
send(cmd)
end

Script.name: farmer
Script.script:
farmer = farmer or {}
farmer.configure = function (runName, steps, completeCallback, options)
options = options or {}
-- convert old dropJunk param to options (so lazy) if (type(options) == 'string') then options = {dropJunk = options} end
options.shortName = runName options.longName = options.longName or runName options.ignoreNoXpMobsUnder = options.ignoreNoXpMobsUnder or 1
options.targets = options.targets or {} options.nonHostileTargets = options.nonHostileTargets or {} options.ignoreTargets = options.ignoreTargets or {} options.nastyTargets = options.nastyTargets or {}
cecho('\n <yellow>FARMER:<white> updated config for ' .. runName .. '\n') farmer.runs = farmer.runs or {} farmer.runs[runName] = { steps = steps, completeCallback = completeCallback, dropJunk = options.dropJunk, options = options } end
farmer.onStepComplete = function(thisStep) -- send next move when the next prompt appears
farmer.advancePending = true
if (thisStep.action) then
-- echo('\n\n <-- speed walk done: running action .. ' .. thisStep.action)
if(type(thisStep.action) == 'string') then expandAlias(thisStep.action) cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>advancing step in 5s (basic action)... ') -- display(thisStep) tempTimer(5, farmer.advance, 'farmer onStepComplete advance') else
-- if action is a function we won't advance until -- the callback is called if(type(thisStep.action) == 'function') then
cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>running action function\n') local nextMurderStep = function () cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>action callback complete, advancing step...\n') farmer.advance() end
-- need to get this into next cycle to prevent action being able to trigger on the current line -- this was problematic when a pfree happened in stepAction then pfull in action as the pfree "ready" -- was taken as "pfull" ready. tempTimer(0, function() thisStep.action(nextMurderStep) end)
else -- unknown action type
cecho('\n<red>FARMER: <white>unkown action type!!\n')
end -- if action was a function
end -- else if action was string
else
cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>advancing step (no action)... \n') farmer.advance()
end
end
farmer.getStep = function(name) for idx, step in pairs(farmer.steps) do if step.name and step.name == name then return step, idx end end
end
farmer.advance = function (stepName)
local thisStep farmer.advancePending = false
if (stepName) then thisStep, farmer.currentStepIdx = farmer.getStep(stepName) else farmer.currentStepIdx = farmer.currentStepIdx + 1 thisStep = farmer.steps[farmer.currentStepIdx] end
if (thisStep) then
cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>starting step ' .. (thisStep.name or tostring(farmer.currentStepIdx)) .. '\n')
if (thisStep.location) then -- standard walk step
-- start heading to the next location... murder.stepAction = thisStep.stepAction tfe.gotoRoom(thisStep.location, function () cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>path complete, running action...\n') farmer.onStepComplete(thisStep) end)
elseif (thisStep.turbo) then -- display(thisStep) tfe.turboWalkToRoom(thisStep.turbo, { callback = function () cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>turbo path complete, running action...\n') farmer.onStepComplete(thisStep) end, stepAction = thisStep.stepAction or farmer.options.stepAction })
elseif (thisStep.waypoints) then -- if this is a murder path murder.execute(thisStep, function () farmer.onStepComplete(thisStep) end) end
else
if stepName then cecho('\n<red>FARMER: <white>attempted to advance to invalid step (' .. stepName .. ')\n') else
echo('\n\nFields are tended! laps: ' .. tostring(farmer.lapCounter) .. ' : ' .. tostring(farmer.killcount) .. '\n\n')
if (farmer.completeCallback) then farmer.completeCallback() end end
end
end
farmer.incKillCount = function () farmer.killcount = (farmer.killcount or 0) + 1 end
farmer.restart = function ()
farmer.endLap(); murder.advancePending = nil farmer.advancePending = nil
if (not farmer.dontRestart) or farmer.reloadBot then farmer.currentStepIdx = 0 farmer.advance() else
local botName = farmer.options.shortName cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>restart skipped (the end!)\n') farmer.stop() murder.stop()
if farmer.reloadBot then cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>reloading/restarting bot in 3 seconds\n') tempTimer(3, function() expandAlias('farm ' .. farmer.options.shortName) end, 'restarting bot') end end
end
farmer.start = function (runName, param)
local specialCommands = {
stop = function () farmer.stop() murder.stop() end,
stopAfter = function ()
if (param ~= 'cancel') then
send('gstat bot stopping at end of this run') farmer.dontRestart = true cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>stopping after current lap...\n')
else send('gstat bot stop cancelled') farmer.dontRestart = nil cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>cancelling stop after current lap...\n') end
end,
reloadAfter = function ()
if (param ~= 'cancel') then
farmer.reloadBot = true cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>reloading bot after current lap...\n')
else farmer.reloadBot = nil cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>reloading bot after current lap...\n') end
end,
pause = function () murder.pause() end,
resume = function () murder.resume() end,
explore = function () murder.explore() end,
reset = function () murder.silenced = nil player.pendingAttack = nil player.equippingSet = nil player.gettingFull = nil murder.powerScanning = nil murder.shortRegroup = nil farmer.advancePending = nil healer.clearQueued() end,
resetStats = function() farmer.resetFarmStats() end,
restartStep = function() farmer.currentStepIdx = farmer.currentStepIdx - 1 farmer.advance() end,
-- forgot to call that callback eh? nextStep = function() farmer.advance() end,
afk = function() if (param == 'true' or param == 'on') then cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>enabling AFK mode...\n') farmer.afkMode = true else cecho('\n<yellow>FARMER: <white>disabling AFK mode...\n') farmer.afkMode = nil end end,
} -- display(runName)
if (farmer.runs[runName]) then
-- send('opt autoscan 0')
specialCommands.reset()
if (farmer.options == nil or farmer.options.shortName ~= runName) then farmer.resetFarmStats() end
farmer.resetLapStats() farmer.dontRestart = nil farmer.reloadBot = nil farmer.onStop = nil
murder.advancePending = nil farmer.advancePending = nil murder.noRegroup = nil
farmer.steps = farmer.runs[runName].steps farmer.dropJunk = farmer.runs[runName].dropJunk farmer.completeCallback = farmer.runs[runName].completeCallback farmer.options = farmer.runs[runName].options farmer.currentStepIdx = 0
if (farmer.options.beforeStart) then cecho('\n<green>FARMER: <white>running before start function...\n')
local bSkipAdvance
bSkipAdvance = farmer.options.beforeStart(function()
if (not bSkipAdvance) then farmer.advance() else cecho('\n<green>FARMER: <white>before start function is skipping initial advacnce...\n') end end)
else
-- nothing to do before starting so advance... farmer.advance() end
else
if (specialCommands[runName]) then specialCommands[runName]() else echo('\n\n\nERRRRROR: no such farm\n\n') end
end
end
farmer.resetFarmStats = function () farmer.lapCounter = 0 farmer.killcount = 0 farmer.startTime = getEpoch() farmer.lapTimes = {} farmer.repopWaitTime = 0 farmer.cumulativeInfo = {} farmer.kills = {} farmer.looted = {} farmer.lootItems = {} end
farmer.resetLapStats = function ()
farmer.lapRepopWaitTime = 0 farmer.lapStartTime = getEpoch() farmer.lapInfo = {}
farmer.lapStartXP = gmcp.Char.Score.xp farmer.lapStartLevel = gmcp.Char.Score.level farmer.lapStartXPneeded = gmcp.Char.Score.xp_needed
end
farmer.endLap = function ()
farmer.lapInfo.xp = gmcp.Char.Score.xp
if (gmcp.Char.Score.level == farmer.lapStartLevel) then farmer.lapInfo.xp = farmer.lapInfo.xp - farmer.lapStartXP else farmer.lapInfo.xp = farmer.lapInfo.xp + farmer.lapStartXPneeded end
farmer.lapInfo.xp = generic.numberShortFormat(farmer.lapInfo.xp)
local laptime = getEpoch() - farmer.lapStartTime
table.insert(farmer.lapTimes, laptime)
farmer.repopWaitTime = farmer.repopWaitTime + farmer.lapRepopWaitTime farmer.lapCounter = (farmer.lapCounter or 0) + 1
farmer.cumulativeInfo["lap times"] = farmer.cumulativeInfo["lap times"] or {} table.insert(farmer.cumulativeInfo["lap times"], math.ceil(farmer.lapRepopWaitTime + laptime))
for k, v in pairs(farmer.lapInfo) do farmer.cumulativeInfo[k] = farmer.cumulativeInfo[k] or {} table.insert(farmer.cumulativeInfo[k], v) end
cecho('\n<green>FARMER: <white>lap restarted after: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(laptime) .. ', repop wait was: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(farmer.lapRepopWaitTime) .. '\n')
display(farmer.lapInfo)
farmer.resetLapStats()
end
farmer.stop = function () if (farmer.startTime) then cecho('\n<red>FARMER:<white> stopped running. runtime: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(getEpoch() - farmer.startTime) .. '\n') send('gstat bot stopped. runtime: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(getEpoch() - farmer.startTime)) end farmer.steps = {} farmer.completeCallback = nil farmer.dropJunk = nil if (farmer.onStop) then farmer.onStop() end end
farmer.status = function(chan)
if (not chan or chan == '') then chan = 'emote :' end
chan = chan .. ' '
if not farmer or not farmer.steps or #farmer.steps == 0 then if (group.leader ~= player.name) then send(chan .. 'status: following ' .. group.leader) else send(chan .. 'status: not currently farming or following') end
else
send(chan .. 'Currently running: ' .. farmer.options.longName)
local totalTime = getEpoch() - farmer.startTime local lapTime = getEpoch() - farmer.lapStartTime
if (totalTime ~= nil and farmer.lapCounter > 0) then send(chan .. 'Average run time: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(totalTime / farmer.lapCounter)) end
if (lapTime ~= nil) then send(chan .. 'Elapsed time this run: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime(lapTime)) end
send(chan .. 'To have me end after this run: tell ' .. player.name .. ' cease and desist')
end
send(chan .. 'Current location: ' .. gmcp.Room.Info.area .. ', ' .. tostring(gmcp.Room.Info.num) .. ' ' .. gmcp.Room.Info.name)
end
farmer.endAfterWithNotify = function(chan)
local totalTime = getEpoch() - farmer.startTime local lapTime = getEpoch() - farmer.lapStartTime
if (not chan or chan == '') then chan = 'emote :' end
chan = chan .. ' '
if #farmer.steps == 0 then send(chan .. 'status: not currently farming') else
if (farmer.dontRestart) then send(chan .. 'already ending after this run') else send(chan .. 'stopping after run completes, will notify when done') farmer.onStop = function () send(chan .. 'finished running ' .. farmer.options.longName) send(chan .. 'to restart tell ' .. player.name .. ' do farm ' .. farmer.options.shortName) if (farmer.options.onStopByTrigger) then farmer.options.onStopByTrigger() end end end
farmer.start('stopAfter')
if (totalTime ~= nil and farmer.lapCounter > 0) then send(chan .. 'eastimated time: ' .. common.formatElapsedTime((totalTime / farmer.lapCounter) - lapTime)) end
end
end
farmer.addMemoryMetrics = function()
farmer.lapInfo = farmer.lapInfo or {} -- local rss = getProcessMemoryUsage() -- local s = getSubsystemMemoryStats()
farmer.lapInfo['RSS'] = math.floor(rss / 1024) -- farmer.lapInfo['lua'] = math.floor(s.lua_heap_kb / 1024) -- farmer.lapInfo['triggers_total'] = s.triggers_total -- farmer.lapInfo['triggers_temp'] = s.triggers_temp -- farmer.lapInfo['timers_total'] = s.timers_total -- farmer.lapInfo['timers_temp'] = s.timers_temp -- farmer.lapInfo['aliases_total'] = s.aliases_total -- farmer.lapInfo['aliases_temp'] = s.aliases_temp -- farmer.lapInfo['event_handlers'] = s.event_handlers -- farmer.lapInfo['map_rooms'] = s.map_rooms
end

Script.name: scanner
Script.script:
------------------------------------------------- -- Put your Lua functions here. -- -- -- -- Note that you can also use external Scripts -- -------------------------------------------------
murder = murder or {}
murder.critters = { rabbit = true, deer = true, fawn = true, -- ["red.robin"] = true, pigeon = true, ["mountain.goat"] = true, ["gray.squirrel"] = true, Ghosty = true, }
murder.setTargets = function (targets, nonHostileTargets, ignoreTargets, nastyTargets)
-- display('targets added...') -- display(targets)
murder.targets = targets or {} murder.nonHostileTargets = nonHostileTargets or {} murder.ignoreTargets = ignoreTargets or {} murder.nastyTargets = nastyTargets or {}
end
murder.resetExits = function () -- echo('\nMurder targets cleared\n') murder.exits = {} end
murder.addExitTarget = function (exit, target, numTargets, numNonHostileTargets, nonTargets, distinctTargets, allTargets, nastyTarget) if exit == '[Here]' then exit = 'here' end -- echo('\nMurder target added?: ' .. exit .. ' : ' .. target) murder.exits[exit] = { firstTarget = target, distinctTargets = distinctTargets, targetCount = numTargets, nonHostileTargetCount = numNonHostileTargets or 0, nonTargetCount = nonTargets or 0, allTargets = allTargets or {}, nastyTarget = nastyTarget, }
end
murder.mountRaces = { unknown = true, insect = true, dragon = true, }
murder.locateMissingMembers = function()
-- nb: will ignore mounts (assuming their race is in the list of known mount races: murder.mountRaces)
-- if (gmcp.Room.Info.name == "Plains of Elemental Mist") then -- bSummonOnly = true -- end
local rollcall = murder.getAwolRoll(true)
local hereList = {}
local recoverList = {} -- gmcp.Char.Score.name
if (njs50.scanner.exits['[Here]']) then for idx, mob in ipairs(njs50.scanner.exits['[Here]']) do if (group.members[mob.raw]) then table.insert(hereList, mob.raw) rollcall[mob.raw] = true end end end
for direction, exit in pairs(njs50.scanner.exits) do
for idx, mob in ipairs(exit) do
if (group.members[mob.raw] and not table.contains(hereList, mob.raw)) then
rollcall[mob.raw] = true
if direction ~= '[Here]' and not murder.mountRaces[group.data[mob.raw].race] then recoverList[direction] = recoverList[direction] or {} table.insert(recoverList[direction], mob.raw) end
end
end
end
for name, isLocated in pairs(rollcall) do if not isLocated and not murder.mountRaces[group.data[name].race] then recoverList.lost = recoverList.lost or {} table.insert(recoverList.lost, name) end end
return recoverList
end
murder.regroup = function(hasRescanned)
local allHere = function() cecho('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> all present and accounted for') farmer.time.namedStop('regroup') murder.gettingLostSheep = nil murder.unhold() murder.resume() killTimer(regroupFailedTimer) end
-- waiting on the rescan before we execute again if (murder.shortRegroup) then common.log('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> pending results of short regroup scan...') return end
-- rescan to hopefully take care of rooms with delayed transfer if not (hasRescanned) then common.log('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> regroup. not a rescan') murder.shortRegroup = true tempTimer(0, function() common.log('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> perforing short regroup scan') common.onNextEvent(njs50.scanner.events.SCAN_PROCESSED, function() tempTimer(0.1, function() common.log('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> short regroup scan completed') murder.shortRegroup = nil murder.regroup(true) end, 'make sure next event has been processed before we rerun regroup') end) murder.scan('regroup scan') end,'delay to prevent retriggering on current scan')
return end common.log('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> regroup: rescan')
local missingList = murder.locateMissingMembers() -- we probably found anyone missing on the rescan if this is true if #table.keys(missingList) == 0 then common.log('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> found missing members on first rescan') allHere() murder.nextStep() return end
local regroupTimeout = 20
local bSummonOnly = false
if (murder.gettingLostSheep) then cecho('\n<orange>REGROUP:<white> already regrouping!!! ') murder.scan('regroup checking scan') return end
if (murder.enabled) then farmer.time.namedStart('regroup') murder.gettingLostSheep = true murder.pause() murder.hold() else cecho('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> skipped as bot is not enabled') return end
cecho('\n<red>REGROUP:<white> initiating regroup - room #' .. gmcp.Room.Info.num)
local regroupFailedTimer = tempTimer(regroupTimeout, function() cecho('\n<red>REGROUP:<white> regroup failed!!! ') murder.gettingLostSheep = nil farmer.time.namedStop('regroup') murder.regroup() end, 'regroup failed')
-- send('gstat up') -- rooms where you arrive before the party members and see them on scan in the previous room. bleh
-- MIA and unrecoverable due to delayed move
local ignoreRegroupRooms = { -- ['66062'] = true, -- barbs going into chief tent via parchment }
if not ignoreRegroupRooms[tostring(gmcp.Room.Info.num)] then send('gtell regroup needed - room #' .. gmcp.Room.Info.num) end
-- in the mist this was a problem: -- [Here] : Rohvan, Darion, Filustyn -- north : Rohvan, Darion, Filustyn -- east : Rohvan, Darion, Filustyn
-- murder.allDo('stand & unhide', function()
common.onNextEvent(njs50.scanner.events.SCAN_PROCESSED, function()
local missingList = murder.locateMissingMembers()
-- display(missingList)
local superLost = missingList.lost missingList.lost = nil
if #table.keys(missingList) > 0 and not ignoreRegroupRooms[tostring(gmcp.Room.Info.num)] then
local ackPending = 0
for exit, vics in pairs(missingList) do
for idx, vic in ipairs(vics) do
cecho('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> recovering ' .. vic .. ' from ' .. exit .. '\n') ackPending = ackPending + 1
-- exits might not be reversable (i.e in the mist on isle) local tankDir = tfe.consts.reverse_dirs[exit]
-- figure out direction from their room to our current room. backup is the reverse dir. -- need this for places like mist in isles where rooms exits are weird if (gmcp.Room.Info.exits[exit]) then for exitDir, vnum in pairs(getRoomExits(gmcp.Room.Info.exits[exit])) do if (vnum == gmcp.Room.Info.num) then cecho('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> ' .. vic .. ' needs to go ' .. exitDir .. '\n') tankDir = exitDir end end end
local recoverString = 'flee ' .. tankDir .. ' & flee ' .. tankDir .. ' & flee ' .. tankDir .. ' & flee ' .. tankDir .. ' & ' .. tankDir
murder.doAnywayAck(vic, recoverString, function()
ackPending = ackPending - 1 if ackPending == 0 then -- restart the regroup to see if everyone is here now... murder.gettingLostSheep = nil killTimer(regroupFailedTimer) cecho('\n<green>REGROUP:<white> theoretically recovered - checking\n') murder.regroup() end
end, 10000)
end
end
cecho('\n<yellow>SCANNER:<white> party member MIA but recoverable!!! ')
elseif ignoreRegroupRooms[tostring(gmcp.Room.Info.num)] then
cecho('\n<orange>SCANNER:<white> in skip regroup room!!!\n') allHere()
elseif superLost then
cecho('\n<red>SCANNER:<white> ' .. table.concat(superLost, ', ') .. ' MIA and unrecoverable!!!\n') tempTimer(5, function() -- restart the regroup to see if everyone is here now... murder.gettingLostSheep = nil killTimer(regroupFailedTimer) tempTimer(regroupTimeout, murder.regroup, 'regroup very lost')
if gmcp.Group.members then for name, deets in pairs(gmcp.Group.members) do if (deets.class == 'cleric') then send('tell ' .. name .. ' do gsummon') end
if (table.contains({'thief', 'druid', 'ranger', 'bard'}, deets.class)) then send('tell ' .. name .. ' do unhide') end
end end
end, 'seeing if missing regroup resolves itself') else allHere() end
end) -- next scan
murder.scan('regroup scan')
-- end) -- end of stand and unhide
end
murder.getAwolRoll = function() local rollcall = common.newRollCall(true)
-- allow us to have a list of players we ignore if -- they are somewhere else if murder.ignoreAwol and #murder.ignoreAwol > 0 then for idx, player in ipairs(murder.ignoreAwol) do if (rollcall[player] == false) then rollcall[player] = true end end end return rollcall end
murder.processScan = function ()
if (murder.scannedRoomNum ~= gmcp.Room.Info.num) then -- cecho('\n<green>SCAN:<white> updating previous exit data\n') -- display(murder.exits) murder.exitsPrevious = { num = murder.scannedRoomNum, contents = murder.exits.here, } end
-- cecho('\n<green>SCAN:<white> processing scan for room #' .. tostring(gmcp.Room.Info.num) .. '\n')
murder.resetExits()
murder.scannedRoomNum = gmcp.Room.Info.num
local getPriority = function(tp) if type(tp) == 'number' then return tp end return 1 end
local isDark = function()
if ( njs50.scanner.exits and njs50.scanner.exits['[Here]'] and njs50.scanner.exits['[Here]'][1].raw == 'darkness' ) then cecho('... spooky ...') return true end return false end
-- only look for things to kill if we are actively looking to murder something if (murder.enabled or murder.exploring or murder.paused) then
local rollcall = murder.getAwolRoll()
for direction, mobs in pairs(njs50.scanner.exits) do
local targetCount = 0 local nonTargetCount = 0 local nonHostileTargetCount = 0 local ignoredTargetCount = 0 local firstTarget = nil local allTargets = {} local rubes = {} local targetPriority = 0 local targetScore = 0
if (mobs[1].raw == 'unknown') then
-- cecho('<yellow> <--- mystery room [' .. direction .. ']')
-- if this is the room we just came from when can use the old scan data if (murder.exitsPrevious and gmcp.Room.Info.exits[direction] == murder.exitsPrevious.num) then
-- cecho('<green> recycling scan for [' .. direction .. ']\n') murder.exits[direction] = murder.exitsPrevious.contents murder.exitsPrevious = nil
else -- replicate old behaviour but add an unknown flag murder.exits[direction] = { allTargets = { "1.unknown" }, distinctTargets = 1, firstTarget = "unknown", nastyTarget = false, nonHostileTargetCount = 0, nonTargetCount = 0, targetCount = 100, unknown = true, } end
else
-- filter out any group members (and mark them off rollcall) mobs = table.n_filter(mobs, function(mob) local isMember = group.members[mob.raw] if (direction == '[Here]' and isMember) then rollcall[mob.raw] = true end return not isMember end)
mobs = table.n_filter(mobs, function(mob) return not murder.critters[mob.killString] end)
-- display(mobs) -- loop over mobs for idx, mob in pairs(mobs) do
local ms = mob.killString local count = mob.count
rubes[ms] = count
-- keep track of the target count (targets) if murder.nastyTargets and murder.nastyTargets[ms] then
if type(murder.nastyTargets[ms]) == 'boolean' then murder.nastyTargets[ms] = 1 end
targetCount = targetCount + count targetScore = targetScore + (murder.nastyTargets[ms] * count)
elseif murder.targets and murder.targets[ms] then
if type(murder.targets[ms]) == 'boolean' then murder.targets[ms] = 1 end
targetCount = targetCount + count targetScore = targetScore + (murder.targets[ms] * count)
-- non hostile targets elseif (murder.nonHostileTargets and murder.nonHostileTargets[ms]) then
if type(murder.nonHostileTargets[ms]) == 'boolean' then murder.nonHostileTargets[ms] = 1 end
nonHostileTargetCount = nonHostileTargetCount + count targetScore = targetScore + (murder.nonHostileTargets[ms] * count)
-- any remaining non ignored targets elseif (not (murder.ignoreTargets[ms] or murder.critters[ms])) then
-- non targets (or not yet found targets) if (murder.exploring) then targetCount = targetCount + count cecho('\n<green>EXPLORER: <white>new target aquired - ' .. ms) murder.targets[ms] = true else -- cecho('<orange>MURDER:<white> adding non target ' .. ms .. '\n') nonTargetCount = nonTargetCount + count end
else
ignoredTargetCount = ignoredTargetCount + count -- ignored target! (do nothing) end
end -- end loop over mobs
local distinctTargets = 0 local nastyTarget = false
if (murder.nastyTargets) then for target, tp in pairs(murder.nastyTargets) do -- echo('\n target is: ' .. target) if rubes[target] then local dotTarg = common.dotCase(target) nastyTarget = true distinctTargets = distinctTargets + 1 if (getPriority(tp) > targetPriority) then firstTarget = dotTarg targetPriority = getPriority(tp) end for i=1, rubes[target] do table.insert(allTargets, tostring(i) .. '.' ..dotTarg) end end end end
if (murder.targets) then for target, tp in pairs(murder.targets) do -- echo('\n target is: ' .. target) if rubes[target] then local dotTarg = common.dotCase(target) distinctTargets = distinctTargets + 1 if (getPriority(tp) > targetPriority) then firstTarget = dotTarg targetPriority = getPriority(tp) end for i=1, rubes[target] do table.insert(allTargets, tostring(i) .. '.' ..dotTarg) end end end end
-- and non hostile targets...
-- gotta do these loops here to allow target priority
if (murder.nonHostileTargets) then for target, tp in pairs(murder.nonHostileTargets) do -- echo('\n target is: ' .. target) if rubes[target] then local dotTarg = common.dotCase(target) if (getPriority(tp) > targetPriority) then firstTarget = dotTarg targetPriority = getPriority(tp) end distinctTargets = distinctTargets + 1 for i=1, rubes[target] do table.insert(allTargets, tostring(i) .. '.' ..dotTarg) end end end end
if (firstTarget) then murder.addExitTarget( direction, firstTarget, -- targetCount, using target score instead of count math.ceil(targetScore), nonHostileTargetCount, nonTargetCount, distinctTargets, allTargets, nastyTarget ) end
end -- end check if contents is unknown
end -- end loop over directsion
tfe.roomInfo.murder_scanned = true
-- we can check the roll call now scan is processed if ( murder.enabled and not murder.holdHere == true and not murder.noRegroup and not isDark() and murder.exitForSleepKill ~= true and not common.rollCheck(rollcall) ) then -- return so as not to return murder.regroup() end
common.log('<green><-- scan processed\n')
raiseEvent(common.events.SCAN_PROCESSED) if (murder.exits.here == nil or murder.exits.here.targetCount == 0) then raiseEvent(common.events.ROOM_CLEAR) end
end -- if scanner is enabled
end
if (murder.scanWatcher) then killAnonymousEventHandler(murder.scanWatcher) murder.scanWatcher = nil end
murder.scanWatcher = registerAnonymousEventHandler(njs50.scanner.events.SCAN_PROCESSED, murder.processScan)

Script.name: team
Script.script:
common.includeInRollCalls = { Mojune = true, Mohoonay = true, Momore = true, Myrth = true, Grehild = true, Darion = true, Darius = true, Bimgore = true, -- Marial = true, -- Grackle = true, -- Raksha = true, -- Gnodrick = true, Grexil = true, Lacopa = true, Mojolas = true, Myranth = true, Ayrevir = true, Batrina = true, Delrina = true, Mojube = true, Summuno = true, Khoren = true, Zultis = true, Myrnath = true,
Cimbore = true, Dimlore = true, Einjore = true,
Findore = true, Gimlore = true, Himzore = true, Ilnore = true, Jimblore = true, Kimsore = true,
}
common.healGroup = function(groupHealer, cb) tempRegexTrigger('^' .. groupHealer .. ' reports group status: "group healed"$', cb, 1) send('gstat ' .. groupHealer .. ' heal group') end
common.comeToMe = function (callback, skipAwol)
local roll
if (skipAwol) then roll = murder.getAwolRoll() else roll = common.newRollCall(true, true) end
if (#table.keys(roll) == 1) then cecho('\n<yellow>COMMON: <white>skipping regroup due to only one party member\n\n') callback() return end
local mcb = callback
tempTimer(2, function ()
local atTrig
local preFetchState = mapper.paused
mapper.paused = true
atTrig = tempRegexTrigger([[^.+ reports group status[^:]*: "(\w+) is now at (\d+)"]], function () if (tostring(tfe.roomInfo.num) == matches[3]) then
roll[matches[2]] = true
if (common.rollCheck(roll)) then mapper.paused = preFetchState send('gstat all here - moving...') killTrigger(atTrig) mcb() end
else send('mutter') send('gstat ' .. matches[2] .. ' go to ' .. tostring(tfe.roomInfo.num)) end
end)
-- send('gstat meet at ' .. tostring(tfe.roomInfo.num))
for player, here in pairs(roll) do
if (not here) then
send('gstat ' .. player .. ' go to ' .. tostring(tfe.roomInfo.num))
end
end
end, 'comeToMe')
end
common.collectFollowers = function (callback)
if (not murder.paused) then murder.pause() end
local roll = common.newRollCall(true)
send('stand & remove blanket')
local outStandingResponses = group.memberCount - 1
local onAllResponded = function ()
for key, value in pairs(roll) do if (value ~= true) then cecho('\n\n<red>MURDER: <white>' .. key .. ' is lost at ' .. tostring(value) .. '\n') tfe.gotoRoom(value, function() tempTimer(3, function() common.collectFollowers(callback) end, 'finding next follower?') end) return end end
-- if we got to here then everyone is here already cecho('\n\n<green>MURDER: <white>everyone is collected now!\n') if (murder.paused) then murder.resume() end callback()
end
tempRegexTrigger([[^.+ reports group status[^:]*: "(\w+) is at (\d+)"]], function ()
local vnum = tonumber(matches[3])
if (tfe.roomInfo.num == vnum) then roll[matches[2]] = true else roll[matches[2]] = vnum end
outStandingResponses = outStandingResponses - 1
if (outStandingResponses == 0) then onAllResponded() end
end, outStandingResponses)
send('gstat where are you?')
end
common.fixConditions = function (callback)
if (not murder.paused) then murder.pause() end
local roll = common.newRollCall(false, true)
local healthyCheckId = tempRegexTrigger([[^.+ reports? group status: "healthy - (\w+)"]], function () local vic = matches[2] if (vic == 'You') then vic = player.name end roll[matches[2]] = true end)
send('gstatus condition report')
tempTimer(5, function ()
killTrigger(healthyCheckId)
if common.rollCheck(roll) then send('gstatus all healthy') if (murder.paused) then murder.resume() end if callback then callback() end else send('gstatus not yet healthy enough... retrying') tempTimer(10, function() common.fixConditions(callback) end, 'waiting for cures before checking conditions') end
end)
end
common.newRollCall = function (excludeSelf, bUseIncludeList)
common.includeInRollCalls[player.name] = true
local roll = {}
for name, value in pairs(group.members) do
if (not bUseIncludeList or common.includeInRollCalls[name]) then roll[name] = false else cecho('<green>Roll:<white> skipping roll call for ' .. name .. '\n') end
-- pets get a free pass if (group.data[name].race == 'unknown') then roll[name] = true end end
if (excludeSelf) then roll[player.name] = true end
return roll
end
common.newExcludedRollCall = function ()
local roll = {}
for name, value in pairs(group.members) do
if (not common.includeInRollCalls[name]) then roll[name] = false else roll[name] = true end
end
roll[player.name] = true
return roll
end
common.rollCheck = function(roll)
for key, value in pairs(roll) do if (not value) then return false end end return true
end
common.sendPlayer = function (player, rnum, callback)
local ncb = callback tempRegexTrigger([[^.+ reports group status[^:]*: "]] .. player .. [[ is now at ]] .. tostring(rnum) .. [["]], function () ncb() end, 1)
send('gstat ' .. player .. ' go to ' .. tostring(rnum))
end
common.sendDruid = function (player, rnum, callback)
if (tfe.locations[rnum]) then rnum = tfe.locations[rnum] end
local ncb = callback tempRegexTrigger([[^.+ reports group status[^:]*: "]] .. player .. [[ is now at ]] .. tostring(rnum) .. [["]], function () ncb() end, 1)
send('gstat ' .. player .. ' landwalk to ' .. tostring(rnum))
end
common.groupOnReady = function (cb)
local grcb = cb
local rct
local roll = common.newRollCall(false, true)
-- i think this is people who don't have my triggers? local naughtyList = common.newExcludedRollCall()
local readyCheck = function ()
if (common.rollCheck(roll)) then -- group members
killTrigger(rct)
if common.rollCheck(naughtyList) and grcb then grcb() else
tempTimer(0, function()
-- now check the naugty list for player, ready in pairs(naughtyList) do
if (not ready) then cecho('<green>Roll:<white> waiting for ' .. player .. ' to stand\n') murder.doAnywayAck(player, 'stand', function()
naughtyList[player] = true if common.rollCheck(naughtyList) and grcb then grcb() end
end) end
end
end, 'delayed execute to prevent double confirming a ready message') end -- end if naughty list
end end
-- display(roll)
rct = tempRegexTrigger([[^.* reports? group status[^:]*: "ready \((.*)\)"]], function () roll[matches[2]] = true readyCheck() end)
end
common.othersReady = function (cb)
local rct
local roll = common.newRollCall(true, true)
local readyCheck = function () if (common.rollCheck(roll)) then -- group members killTrigger(rct) cb() end end
rct = tempRegexTrigger([[^.* reports? group status[^:]*: "ready \((.*)\)"]], function () roll[matches[2]] = true readyCheck() end)
end
common.selfManagedPrepIfUnder = function(healer, spell, amount, callback)
group.prepped = group.prepped or {} group.prepped[healer] = group.prepped[healer] or {} group.prepped[healer].spell = group.prepped[healer].spell or '' group.prepped[healer].amount = group.prepped[healer].amount or 0
if ( group.prepped[healer].spell == spell and group.prepped[healer].amount >= amount ) then
send('gstat ' .. healer .. ' has enough ' .. spell .. ' prepped to continue (' .. tostring(group.prepped[healer].amount) .. ')') callback()
else
send('gstat ' .. healer .. ' needs another ' .. tostring(amount - group.prepped[healer].amount) .. ' '.. spell .. ' prepped to continue')
common.groupPrepFree(function() -- there used to be a delay here, but going through a prepFree seems like enough to me common.selfManagedPrepIfUnder(healer, spell, amount, callback) end)
end
end
common.groupPrepIfUnder = function (options)
local cb = options.callback or function() end
local cmd = 'gstat report if '
local cleanUp, ttt, rcTrig
if (options.mana) then cmd = cmd .. 'mana < ' .. tostring(options.mana) .. '%, ' end
if (options.heals) then cmd = cmd .. 'heals < ' .. tostring(options.heals) .. 'hp, ' end
if (options.storms) then cmd = cmd .. 'storms < ' .. tostring(options.storms) .. ', ' end
cmd = cmd:gsub(', $', '')
local sendPrepMessage = function()
if (options.prepType == 'full') then send('gstat pfull') elseif (options.prepType == 'free') then send('gstat pfree') else send('gstat get ready') end
end
local prepFn = function()
cecho('\n<green>COMMON: <white>time to prep!\n')
cleanUp()
local prepTimedOut = tempTimer(120, function() send('gstat wtf are we waiting on...') send('gtell TIMED OUT WAITING FOR PREP - was gstat ignored again?') sendPrepMessage() end, true)
common.groupOnReady(function () send('gstat mudering continues') killTimer(prepTimedOut) cb() end)
if (generic.hasAffect("legate's pride")) then send("leech legate's pride") end
sendPrepMessage()
end
local contFn = function() cleanUp() send('gstat mudering continues') tempTimer(0, cb, 'delayed execute to prevent double triggering on a ready line') end
ttt = njs50.timedTempTrigger(10, 1, [[^[^"]+ reports? group status: "need prep"$]], function()
ttt = nil prepFn() end, function() ttt = nil contFn() end)
local roll = common.newRollCall(false, true)
rcTrig = tempRegexTrigger([[^(.*) reports? group status: "prepared enough"$]], function() local vic = matches[2] if vic == 'You' then vic = player.name end roll[vic] = true
if (common.rollCheck(roll)) then contFn() end
end)
cleanUp = function() if (ttt) then killTimer(ttt.timerId) killTrigger(ttt.triggerId) end killTrigger(rcTrig) end
send(cmd)
end
common.groupPrepFree = function (cb)
if (group.memberCount == 1) then cecho('\n<yellow>COMMON: <white>skipping group prep full due to only one party member\n\n') player.prepFull(cb) return end
common.groupOnReady(function () send('gstat pfree completed') if (cb) then cb() end end)
send('gstat pfree')
end
common.groupPrepFull = function (cb)
local pfcb = cb
if (group.memberCount == 1) then cecho('\n<yellow>COMMON: <white>skipping group prep full due to only one party member\n\n') player.prepFull(pfcb) return end
common.groupOnReady(function () send('gstat up') if (pfcb) then tempTimer(3, pfcb, 'wait for up') end end)
send('gstat pfull')
end

Script.name: instrumenting
Script.script:
farmer.time = farmer.time or {}
farmer.time.namedStart = function(name) farmer.time.named = farmer.time.named or {} farmer.time.named[name] = getEpoch() end
farmer.time.namedStop = function(name, callback)
farmer.time.namedTimes = farmer.time.namedTimes or {}
if (not farmer.time.namedTimes[name]) then cecho('\n\n<red>MURDER:<white> named timer stoped but wasn\'t started - ' .. name .. '\n\n') else farmer.time.namedTimes[name] = farmer.time.namedTimes[name] or 0 farmer.time.namedTimes[name] = farmer.time.namedTimes[name] + getEpoch() - farmer.time.named[name] farmer.lapInfo = farmer.lapInfo or {} farmer.lapInfo[name] = math.ceil(farmer.time.namedTimes[name]) end
if (callback) then callback() end end
farmer.time.reset = function(name) farmer.time.namedTimes = farmer.time.namedTimes or {} for val, name in pairs(table.keys(farmer.time.namedTimes)) do farmer.time.namedTimes[name] = 0 end end
farmer.time.snoozeStart = function() farmer.time.namedStart('snooze_time') end
farmer.time.snoozeStop = function() farmer.time.namedStop('snooze_time') end
farmer.incrementLapInfo = function(name) farmer.lapInfo[name] = farmer.lapInfo[name] or 0 farmer.lapInfo[name] = farmer.lapInfo[name] + 1 end

Script.name: farmer.lootedItems
Script.script:
farmer.getBaseItem = function(item) item = rex.gsub(item, [[(^an? |^the |\+chaotic\+,? |\+lawful\+,? |\+evil\+,? |\+good\+,? |thanatotic,? |acid-dripping,? |divinely flamed,? |enchanted,? |empty,? |spiteful,? |jinxing,? |flaming,? |labeled )]], '') item = rex.gsub(item, [[(slightly rusty |very rusty |rusty |slightly tarnished |very tarnished |tarnished )]], '') return item end
farmer.lootedItems = function(_, source, items)
-- display(source, items)
source = rex.gsub(source, [[^the corpse of ]], '')
farmer.looted = farmer.looted or {} farmer.lootItems = farmer.lootItems or {}
-- display('looted items:', source, items)
if player.name == group.leader then
if not ( table.contains({'deposit', 'get', 'junk'}, source) or rex.match(source, [[ labeled ]]) or #table.keys(items) == 0 ) then
local sourceKillName = farmer.lastMobKilled or 'unknown'
farmer.looted[source] = farmer.looted[source] or {}
if sourceKillName:upper() ~= source:upper() then farmer.looted[source]["_name"] = sourceKillName end
farmer.looted[source]["_kills"] = (farmer.looted[source]["_kills"] or 0) + 1
for item, qty in pairs(items) do
local baseItem = farmer.getBaseItem(item)
farmer.looted[source][item] = (farmer.looted[source][item] or 0) + qty
if (not farmer.lootItems[baseItem]) then farmer.lootItems[baseItem] = true send('gtell new item found: ' .. baseItem) end
end
end
end
end

Script.name: player.beach.imps
Script.script:
bots = bots or {} bots.beach = bots.beach or {}
farmer.afterCommonLoaded(function ()
local useTobacco = false
bots.beach.getImproveCommand = function(exit)
if (improves.sawPrac) then
cecho('\n<green>IMPS:<white> waiting for prac timer to cool down\n')
if (gmcp.Char.Status.position ~= 'sleeping') then send('sleep') murder.hold()
tempTimer(math.max(improves.pracReleaseAt - getEpoch(), 0), function() send('stand') murder.unhold() end, 'regen') end
return '' end
if (exit and exit.firstTarget) then return improves.improveCombat(player.improveThings, exit.firstTarget) else return '' end
end
-- -- function(exit) -- -- if (improves.sawAction) then -- cecho('\n<green>IMPS:<white> waiting for action timer to cool down\n') -- return '' -- end -- -- -- check if any of our buffs need to be queued for improves -- njs50.respell(player.buffs, {queueSpellImprove = true}) -- -- -- -- if no imp queued then do the murdery type move -- if (#improves.castQueue == 0) then -- -- if (exit and exit.firstTarget) then -- return improves.improveCombat(player.improveThings, exit.firstTarget) -- else -- return '' -- end -- -- else -- -- if (improves.castFillerLastTick ~= false) then -- improves.castFillerLastTick = false -- -- improves.sawAction = true -- if (improves.actionRelease) then -- killTimer(improves.actionRelease) -- end -- improves.actionRelease = tempTimer(40, function() -- -- send('stand & |scan') -- improves.actionRelease = nil -- improves.sawAction = nil -- improves.releaseAt = nil -- end, 'combat, sawAction reset') -- -- if (useTobacco) then -- murder.smokeUp('imps-no-wis','imps-regen', 3, function() -- improves.castSpell() -- send('wait 3') -- end) -- else -- improves.castSpell() -- send('wait 3') -- end -- return '' -- end -- -- end
-- end
local options = {
longName = 'beach.imps',
targets = { ["sea.gull"] = 1, ["small.green.crab"] = 1, ["large.fish"] = 1, ["lobster"] = 1, ["pelican"] = 1, },
getKillCommand = bots.beach.getImproveCommand,
onStopByTrigger = function () send('stop was commanded - begin self destruct sequence') end,
}
local steps = {
{ waypoints = {21039}, -- repop action = function (cb) send('group -l Lacopa') -- common.comeToMe(function () -- common.groupPrepFull(function () improves.sawAction = false -- njs50bot.sleepUntilFull(function() -- cb() common.checkRepopByDrop(22000, [[^\S+ \w+ coins? lies?]], cb, 5) -- end) -- end) -- end) end, }, { waypoints = { 22000 }, action = "drop silver.coin" }, { waypoints = {22040, 22009, 22030, 22033, 22002, 22000, 22031} },
{ waypoints = {21039}, -- repop },
}
local completeCallback = function () send('gstat beach.imps is done...') -- expandAlias('sort beach.imps junk') tempTimer(5, function () farmer.restart() end) end
farmer.configure('player.beach.imps', steps, completeCallback, options)
end)

Script.name: player.trog.imps
spooky isle
Script.script:
isle = isle or {}
local turnIn = { ["a Seafoam Sisterhood Credit Voucher"] = true, ["a hard, green gooseberries"] = true, ["a hard, green gooseberry"] = true, ["a honey brown uncut gem"] = true, ["a honey brown uncut barite gem"] = true, -- ["lustrous golden cube"] = true, ["a triangular seed"] = true, ["an octagonal seed"] = true, ["a pentagonal seed"] = true, ["a raw oblong brown root"] = true, ["a tiny orange bloom"] = true, ["a tri-colored feather"] = true, ["an uncut pink gemstone"] = true, ["a yellow and black cup-shaped flower"] = true, ["a yellow-tipped dingy white feather"] = true, ["a dewberry"] = true, ["a nightstalker's claw"] = true, -- ["an unblemished sand-colored naga scale"] = true, -- ["a sand-colored naga scale"] = true, -- ["an unblemished rainbow naga scale"] = true, -- ["a rainbow naga scale"] = true, ["a twisted silvery horn"] = true, ["an ancient glass inkwell"] = true, ["an ancient quills"] = true, ["an ancient quill"] = true, ["a broken crystalline marble"] = true, ["a tiny golden statuette of a dancer"] = true, ["a tiny golden statuettes of a dancer"] = true, ["an enchanted twisted silvery horn"] = true, ["a cracked ceramic candle holder"] = true, }
isle.withdraw = function()
for item in pairs(turnIn) do item = common.itemShorten(item) send('with all.' .. item .. ' & |put all.' .. item .. ' loot') end
end
isle.crone = function(callback)
common.onNextEvent(common.events.PARSED_CONTENTS, function(evt, container, contents)
display(contents)
local co local cmdCount = 0
co = coroutine.create(function()
for item, qty in pairs(contents) do if (turnIn[item] or turnIn[rex.gsub(item, [[s$]], '')]) then -- expandAlias('cr ' .. tostring(qty) .. '*' .. common.itemShorten(item))
item = common.itemShorten(item)
for i = 1, qty do send('get ' .. item .. ' loot' .. ' & give ' .. item .. ' crone') cmdCount = cmdCount + 1 if cmdCount % 30 == 0 then tempBeginOfLineTrigger([[You tap your foot impatiently.]], function() tempTimer(0, function() local ok, errorMsg = coroutine.resume(co) if not ok then error("Error in co-routine crone: " .. errorMsg) end end, 'dont resume til we finish with this triggering line') end, 1) send('|tap') coroutine.yield() end
end
end
end
send('|to crone cash') send('|put all.token,vouch loot')
if (callback) then callback() end
end)
local ok, errorMsg = coroutine.resume(co) if not ok then error("Error in co-routine crone: " .. errorMsg) end
end)
send('|look in loot')
end
isle.depositLoot = function(callback)
expandAlias('sort spooky.isle junk')
tfe.turboWalkToRoom('crone', function()
send('drop all.black.leather.armor,all.soft.leather.armor')
send('gl')
isle.crone(function()
expandAlias('sort spooky.isle junk') tfe.turboWalkToRoom('narakBank', function()
send('gl') expandAlias('db loot all.reagent') expandAlias('db loot all.reagent') expandAlias('db loot all.reagent') expandAlias('db loot all.reagent') expandAlias('db loot all.reagent') expandAlias('db loot all.reagent') expandAlias('db loot all.reagent,all.token') send('pl')
tempTimer(3, function() callback() end)
end)
end)
end)
-- send('gl') -- expandAlias('db loot all.coin,all.crude.obsid.skirt,all.broken.mino.horn,all.tiny.pouch,' .. -- 'all.uncut.stone,cube.heavy,all.bru.rose,all.coch,all.ivory-.clea,all.scapula,' .. -- 'all.machet,all.silv.chain,all.heav.mith.morn,all.smok.ore') -- send('pl') -- send('|with 50') -- -- -- good to continue -- callback() end

Script.name: fire.ants
Script.script:
farmer.afterCommonLoaded(function ()
local useTobacco = true
local getImproveCommand = function(exit)
if (improves.sawPrac) then
cecho('\n<green>IMPS:<white> waiting for prac timer to cool down\n')
if (gmcp.Char.Status.position ~= 'sleeping') then send('sleep') murder.hold()
tempTimer(math.max(improves.pracReleaseAt - getEpoch(), 0), function() send('stand') murder.unhold() end, 'regen') end
return '' end
if (exit and exit.firstTarget) then return improves.improveCombat(player.improveThings, exit.firstTarget) else return '' end
end
local options = {
longName = 'fire.ants',
targets = { ["fire.ant.worker"] = 1, ["fire.ant.drone"] = 1, ["fire.ant.soldier"] = 1, ["fire.ant.dron"] = 1, },
waitForSplitAmount = 10,
notifyMobBeforeMove = true,
onStopByTrigger = function () send('stop was commanded - begin self destruct sequence') end,
getKillCommand = getImproveCommand,
}
local steps = { -- east : a fire ant drone -- { waypoints = {42579}, -- repop action = function (cb) if (farmer.lapCounter == 0) then send('group -l ' .. player.name) improves.sawAction = false improves.sawPrac = false end common.groupPrepFull(function ()
common.scanRepopCheck(table.keys(options.targets), function() if (useTobacco) then murder.smokeUp('imps-no-wis','imps', 22, function() cb() end) else cb() end end, 5) end) end, },
{ waypoints = {43503, 43511, 43514}, -- murder path },
{ waypoints = {43500}, -- pre repop },
{ waypoints = {42579}, -- repop },
}
local completeCallback = function () send('gstat fire.ants is done...') expandAlias('sort fire.ants junk') farmer.restart() end
farmer.configure('fire.ants', steps, completeCallback, options)
end)

Script.name: western expanses
generic prep / sleep / stand
Script.script:
player = player or {} generic = generic or {}
generic.fixAffects = function(options)
-- using default options to allow skipping because i'm too lazy to check -- if the healer has the right spells yet for opt, val in pairs(player.defaultOptions or {}) do if options[opt] == nil then options[opt] = val end end
-- if we aren't even going to try to fix if options.skipFixAffects then return false end
-- or if nobody needs fixing if #table.keys(group.needsFix) == 0 then return false end
-- remove things we can't fix: local spellLevels = { cleric = { ['cure poison'] = 7, ['cure blindness'] = 10, ['cure disease'] = 23, ['neutralize'] = 27, ['purify'] = 47, }
}
-- rabies: need to add some logic here to make sure the healer actually has the right spells local healer = options.healer if (healer == 'Bimgore' and group.members.Mojube) then healer = 'Mojube' end
local healerClass, healerLevel
if healer == gmcp.Char.Score.name then healerClass = gmcp.Char.Score.class healerLevel = gmcp.Char.Score.level else healerClass = gmcp.Group.members[healer].class healerLevel = gmcp.Group.members[healer].level end
-- fix the healer first (most important if they are blind) -- group.needsFix -- previously was just in: player.needsStatusFix
local members = table.keys(group.members) table.remove(members, table.index_of(members, healer)) table.insert(members, 1, healer)
local pendingFix = false
for idx, member in ipairs(members) do if group.needsFix[member] then
for _idx, spell in ipairs(group.needsFix[member]) do if spellLevels[healerClass] and spellLevels[healerClass][spell] and healerLevel >= spellLevels[healerClass][spell] then send('gstat ' .. healer .. ' can you cast ' .. spell .. ' ' .. member) pendingFix = true end end end end
return pendingFix
-- -- -- need purify -- if (generic.hasAffect('confuse') or generic.hasAffect('curse') or generic.hasAffect('slow')) then -- send('gstat ' .. healer .. ' can you cast purify ' .. player.name) -- return true -- end -- -- -- need neutralize -- if (generic.hasAffect('hallucinate') or generic.hasAffect('silence') or generic.hasAffect('acidic venom')) then -- send('gstat ' .. healer .. ' can you cast neutralize ' .. player.name) -- return true -- end -- -- -- need cb -- if (generic.hasAffect('blind')) then -- send('gstat ' .. healer .. ' can you cast cure blind ' .. player.name) -- return true -- end -- -- -- need cb -- if (generic.hasAffect('poison')) then -- send('gstat ' .. healer .. ' can you cast cure poison ' .. player.name) -- return true -- end
-- return false
end
generic.revitSelf = function()
if (gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmv - gmcp.Char.Vitals.mv > 160 or gmcp.Char.Vitals.mv < 15) then if catalog.isWearing('white gold ring') then send('raise ring') end end
end
generic.topOff = function(options)
options.maxLostHp = options.maxLostHp or (gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp * 0.1)
if (gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp - gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp) < options.maxLostHp then
send('gstat Have enough hp to skip top off') options.callback()
else
if (options.healer == 'Bimgore' and group.members.Mojube ) then options.healer = 'Mojube' end
tempBeginOfLineTrigger(options.healer .. ' reports group status: "' .. player.name .. ' healed"', function()
options.callback()
end, 1)
send('gstat ' .. options.healer .. ' top off ' .. player.name)
end
end
generic.stepAction = function(options)
options.healsRequired = options.healsRequired or 400
cecho('\n<green>MURDER:<white> generic.stepAction invoked\n')
njs50.search()
if generic.fixAffects(options) then tempTimer(10, function() generic.stepAction(options) end, 'delay for fixing affect') return end
if (not murder.sawAction) then common.log('\n<green>MURDER:<white> no action, no prep check\n') return options.callback() end
farmer.time.namedStart('step_heal_time')
local prepType = 'standing'
if (options.allowSleep) then prepType = 'full' end
expandAlias('check weapons')
local postHeal = function(healer) generic.topOff({
healer = healer,
maxLostHp = options.maxLostHp,
callback = function()
common.groupPrepIfUnder({ mana = 25, heals = options.healsRequired, storms = 2, prepType = prepType, callback = function() farmer.time.namedStop('step_heal_time') options.callback() end, })
send('gstat time to drop ' .. farmer.options.shortName .. ' junk')
end }) end
if (options.healer == 'Bimgore' and group.members.Darion) then
generic.groupHeal(options.healer, function() postHeal('Darion') end)
else postHeal(options.healer) end
end
-- only checks self w/no healing step generic.lessSafeStepAction = function(options)
njs50.search()
if (murder.sawAction) then send('inventory') end
if options.healer and generic.fixAffects(options) then tempTimer(10, function() generic.lessSafeStepAction(options) end, 'delay for fixing affect') return end
local targetEn = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxen * 0.3 local targetMv = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmv * 0.5 local targetHp = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp * 0.70
if common.checkResources(targetHp, targetEn, targetMv) then cecho('\n<green>PREP: <white>ready enough already. skipping step action\n') options.callback() else
if (options.healer) then generic.topOff(options) else if (options.allowSleep) then common.groupPrepFull(options.callback) else common.groupPrepFree(options.callback) end end
end
end
generic.prepFull = function (callback)
if (not player.gettingFull) then
player.gettingFull = true -- in case we are interrupted and this isn't reset common.onNextEvent(tfe.events.ROOM_CHANGED, function() player.gettingFull = nil end)
generic.getFull(function () player.gettingFull = nil send('gstat ready (' .. player.name .. ')') if (callback) then callback() end end)
else send('gstat already getting full...') end
end
generic.prepFree = function (callback)
local cb = callback or function() end
local targetEn = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxen * 0.3 local targetMv = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmv * 0.6 local targetHp = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp * 0.75
if common.checkResources(targetHp, targetEn, targetMv) then send('gstat ready (' .. player.name .. ')') cb() return else cecho('\n<green>PREP<white>: standing around for regen\n') tempTimer(10, function() generic.prepFree(callback) end, 'waiting for resources') end
if (callback) then callback() end end
generic.equipSleep = function (post_change_cmd, callback)
send('dismount & stand') -- send('gs') equipPartial('sleep', function () player.sleepGear = true send('sit rug & sit couch & sit sofa & sit bed & sit bench & sit chair & sit mat & sit boulder') send(post_change_cmd) if (callback) then callback() end end)
end
generic.equipStand = function (callback) send('stand') resetGear(function() player.sleepGear = false send('stand & mount & group') if (callback) then callback() end end) end
generic.getFull = function (callback)
cecho('\n<green>PREP: <white>start prep full')
local cb = callback or function() end
local targetEn = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxen * 0.3 local targetMv = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmv * 0.6 local targetHp = gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp * 0.90
if common.checkResources(targetHp, targetEn, targetMv) then cecho('\n<green>PREP: <white>full enough already. skipping pfull\n') cb() return end
local sleepCmd = 'sleep' if player.skills.meditate and player.skills.meditate > 0 then sleepCmd = 'meditate' end
generic.equipSleep(sleepCmd, function ()
common.onFullish(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp * 0.9, targetEn, targetMv, function ()
generic.equipStand( cb ) -- end equip stand gear
end) -- end get full mana
end) -- end equip sleep gear
end
-- player.prepFull = player.prepFull or generic.prepFull

Script.name: player.rescue
generic helpers
Script.script:
generic.toggleFlag = function(flag, cmd, setValue)
local isSet = table.contains(gmcp.Char.Status.flags, flag)
if setValue ~= isSet then send(cmd) send('gstat setting ' .. flag .. ' to ' .. tostring(setValue)) else send('gstat no change to ' .. flag .. ' required') end
end
generic.sneak = function(bSneak) generic.toggleFlag("sneaking", 'sneak', bSneak) end
generic.parry = function(bSneak) generic.toggleFlag("parry", 'opt parry', bSneak) end
generic.getPreppedCount = function()
for idx, data in ipairs(gmcp.Char.Prepare) do if data.Spell == player.prep_spell then return data.Prepared end end
return 0 end
generic.reportCount = function () send('gstatus prepped ' .. tostring(generic.getPreppedCount()) .. ' ' .. player.prep_spell .. ', ' .. tostring(gmcp.Char.Vitals.en) .. 'e' ) end

Script.name: prep / sleep / stand
Script.script:
harb = harb or {}
harb.prepFull = function(cb)
harb.prepFree(cb)
end
harb.prepFree = function(cb)
expandAlias('check weapons')
njs50.respell(player.buffs, { target = target, callback = function()
harb.prep(function() generic.reportCount() send('|gstat ready (' .. player.name .. ')') if (cb) then cb() end end)
end })
end
harb.prep = function (callback)
local prepped = generic.getPreppedCount() local amount = common.getPrepAmount(player.prep_cost, player.reserve_mp or 0)
if (amount > 0) then cecho('\n<green>PREP: <white>prepping ' .. tostring(amount) .. ' ' .. player.prep_spell .. ' with free juice') common.prep(player.prep_spell, prepped + amount, callback) else cecho('\n<green>PREP: <white>prep not required') callback() end
end
harb.checkPrep = function()
if (player.skills.cacophony and player.skills.cacophony > 1 and gmcp.Char.Vitals.en > player.reserve_mp + player.prep_cost) then -- prep cacophony cecho('\n<green>PREP<white>: needs to prep cacophony') send('gstat need prep') return end
local affects = generic.getAffects()
for spell, affectText in pairs(player.buffs) do if (player.skills[spell] and player.skills[spell] > 0 and not affects[affectText]) then cecho('\n<green>PREP<white>: needs to respell') send('gstat need prep') return end end
end
